描述_ZN: A blue and white lily-wrapped double-ringed ear vase, Ming Yongle, 46 cm high, 7 cm in diameter, 35 cm in back.　　The vase has a straight mouth and short neck, with a raised neck with a one-week string pattern, decorated on one side with a small tie. The vase is flattened and unglazed on one side, with the center recessed like an umbilicus, and raised on the other side, with the center protruding like a hemisphere, with a live ring ear on each side of the shoulder. The entire body is decorated in blue and white, with the mouth rim decorated with a wrap-around flower, the raised abdomen decorated with an octagonal brocade pattern of seawater and river cliffs, the interior painted with a wrap-around flower, its periphery decorated with a wrap-around flower, and the sides of the bottle decorated with a seawater and river cliffs pattern. The blue and white colors are rich and lustrous, and the decoration is smooth and natural, with a strong sense of movement.　　This vessel is unique in shape, large in size and resembling a turtle, and was fired under the influence of West Asian culture to imitate the shape of Arabian bronze vessels, also known as "reclining pots".

描述_ZN: Doucai Sanqiu cup, Ming Chenghua, 3.9 cm high, 6.9 cm in diameter, 2.6 cm in foot diameter.　　The Chenghua doucai cup has various styles, of which this cup is one. The cup has a flared mouth, a deep belly, a thin foot, and a rounded footrim. The interior of the cup is plain and without decoration. The outer wall is painted with two groups of floral designs of mountains and rocks, interspersed with fluttering butterflies. The blue and white color is light and elegant, and the overglaze colors applied are red, yellow and beautiful purple. The purple color applied on the butterfly wings is the famous beautiful purple color, which is characterized by its dense color and no light, and is the only Chenghua doucai, and is also unmatched by later generations of imitations. It depicts the scenery in a garden or courtyard in autumn, which generally lasts for three months, and is therefore known as the "three autumn cups". The footrim is covered with white glaze. On the outer foot, the two sides are framed in blue and white, with a six-character, double-line mark in blue and white regular script, "Made in the year of Chenghua of the Ming Dynasty".　　The cup is light and graceful, the body is as thin as a cicada's wing, the coloring is light and elegant, and the painting is fresh. The butterflies flying among the flowers and plants are especially vivid, reflecting the painter's excellent painting skills and artistic cultivation.

描述_ZN: Black glaze carved jade vase, Song dynasty, 21 cm high, 6.5 cm in diameter, 7.5 cm in foot.　　The vase has a skewed mouth, a thin neck, a rounded, drooping belly, and a rounded footrim. In terms of decoration, a week of light-colored decorative bands are revealed on the dark-colored ware, which is quite eye-catching.　　In the Tang Dynasty, Si Kongtu's "Poetry - Elegance" has the phrase "jade jug for spring, enjoying the rain and loess huts; a good man in the seat, cultivating bamboo around". The jade pot spring vase was shaped in the Song Dynasty, and then gradually transformed into a decorative vessel. It is a typical piece of Chinese porcelain.

描述_EN: amber, which was imported from burma or the baltic area, was a particularly rare material in china except during the liao (907–1115), yuan, and qing (1644–1911) dynasties, when nomadic imperial houses’ firm control of the central asian trade routes led to increased supplies. it provides evidence for the free flow of trade goods across the silk road as well as the contact between ancient china and other parts of the world. this carving of a dragon climbing across an ornamental garden rock exemplifies the richly articulated sculptural treatment of precious materials created during the yuan dynasty (1271–1368). the spirited dragon illustrates the continuation of the dynamic art of the tang dynasty (618–907) in northern china in the following centuries.
描述_ZN: 从缅甸或波罗的海地区进口的琥珀，在中国是一种特别罕见的材料，除了在辽（907-1115）、元和清（1644-1911）朝代，当时游牧民族的皇室对中亚贸易路线的牢固控制导致供应增加。 它为丝绸之路上贸易货物的自由流动以及古代中国与世界其他地区的联系提供了证据。 这幅龙爬过观赏性花园岩石的雕刻，体现了元代（1271-1368年）对珍贵材料的丰富的雕塑处理。 这条活泼的龙说明了唐代（618-907）的动态艺术在随后几个世纪在中国北方的延续。

描述_EN: a variety of soapstones, particularly those from fujian and zhejiang provinces on china's southeastern coast, quickly became the preferred material, chosen for their fine texture, attractive colors, subtle luster, sensuous feel, and jadelike translucence. seal carving became an important branch of chinese literati art during the late sixteenth century, when artists began using soft stones, or soapstones, for the craft. as the extensive exploitation in the last few centuries has practically exhausted their sources, they are now in extremely limited supply.this pair of seals, each a square prism with a gently curving top, are made of duchengkang stone, which is named after the site of its occurrence in fujian province and celebrated for its mellow amber color and fine grain. on their smoothly polished surface, clouds and rocks, common decorative motifs on the sides of seals, are skillfully and fluidly carved in low relief. these stones have since been held in the highest esteem by artists and collectors alike.
描述_ZN: 各种皂石，特别是那些来自中国东南沿海的福建和浙江的皂石，很快就成为首选材料，因为它们质地细腻，颜色诱人，光泽微妙，手感细腻，有如玉石的半透明。 印章雕刻在十六世纪末成为中国文人艺术的一个重要分支，当时艺术家们开始使用软石，或肥皂石来制作。 由于过去几个世纪的广泛开采几乎耗尽了它们的资源，它们现在的供应量极其有限。这对印章，每个都是一个方形的棱镜，顶部轻轻弯曲，是由杜仲康石制成的，杜仲康石是以它在福建省的产地命名的，以其醇厚的琥珀色和精细的纹理而闻名。 在光滑的抛光表面上，云朵和岩石是印章侧面常见的装饰图案，以低浮雕的方式巧妙而流畅地雕刻出来。 这些石头从此受到艺术家和收藏家的高度尊重。

描述_ZN: The eight-volume "Jomei Xuan Ron" is a study of the "Korema Sutra" written by Jia Xiang (549-623), a great master of the Sanlun school of Buddhism during the Sui Dynasty in China. This manuscript is the oldest Buddhist scripture in Japan with a copying date of December 706, and is well known as one of the rarest and most valuable manuscripts in the history of classical sutra copying. Of the eight scrolls, the first scroll was copied in the Heian period (794-1185), the second and fifth scrolls in the Kamakura period (1185-1333), and the other three scrolls, with the exception of the seventh and eighth scrolls, were copied at the beginning. The calligraphic style of the scrolls, which has the flavor of the Six Dynasties, is a valuable document in the history of calligraphy, and the kunten marks attached to each scroll are also noteworthy from the viewpoint of Japanese linguistics.

藏品名称_EN: Maki-e lacquerware with cloud and dragon pattern
描述_EN: A 16-petal flower-shaped daikago (food basket). The design includes a five-clawed dragon in the center of the lid's surface, bordered by a palace lantern and surrounded by four dragons, interspersed with cloud patterns, flames, and jewels. The petal-shaped interior on either side of the lid is decorated with cloud and dragon motifs, with clouds and bats at the joints, and with repeated lapidary and sumeru on either side of the vessel. These motifs were painted in black, vermilion, green and yellow lacquer, then carved with gold leaf to create the outlines and fill in, a technique known as zongxing. This technique is known as "zongxing". Zongxing flourished in China during the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) and was imported to Japan as a highly prized lacquerware product. Judging from its large, powerful shape and the form of the cloud and dragon motif, this piece is thought to have been made around the Wanli period (1573-1619).
描述_ZN: 一个16瓣的花形daikago（食品篮）。 设计包括盖子表面中央的五爪龙，边上有宫灯，周围有四条龙，中间穿插着云纹、火焰和珠宝。 盖子两侧的花瓣形内饰有云龙纹，接合处有云和蝙蝠，器身两侧反复有立波和须弥山。 这些图案是用黑色、朱色、绿色和黄色的漆画出来的，然后用金箔刻出轮廓并填满，这种技术被称为宗兴。 这种技术被称为 "宗兴"。 宗兴在中国明朝（1368-1644）时期非常兴盛，并作为一种非常珍贵的漆器产品被进口到日本。 从其巨大、有力的外形和云龙图案的形式来看，这件作品被认为是在万历年间（1573-1619）左右制作的。

描述_EN: Butterflies change from caterpillars and larvae through chrysalis to adults. The ancient Japanese were mystified by this change and apparently saw the spirits of the dead in the butterflies that emerged from their suspended state and flew away. In literature, they were also seen as fallible and unreliable. However, when the positive image of the butterfly was imported from China, its beautiful, petite appearance was used as a decorative element in the culture of the Heian Dynasty (794-1185). Thereafter, it was established as a motif depicted alongside autumn grasses and folding flowers. A washbasin is a device used to collect hot water for washing, bathing or giving birth. They were also part of the wedding furniture and were beautifully decorated.
描述_ZN: 蝴蝶从毛毛虫和幼虫经过蛹变成了成虫。 古代日本人对这种变化感到神秘，显然在那些从悬浮状态中出现并飞走的蝴蝶身上看到了死者的灵魂。 在文学作品中，它们也被视为易变和不可靠的东西。 然而，当蝴蝶的正面形象从中国传入后，它美丽、娇小的外表在平安王朝（794-1185）的文化中被用作装饰元素。 此后，它被确立为一种与秋草和折枝花一起描绘的图案。 洗脸盆是一种用来收集洗脸、洗澡或分娩用的热水的装置。 它们也是婚礼家具的一部分，并被装饰得非常漂亮。

藏品名称_EN: Bronze mirror, excavated from the Usa-Akatsuka burial mound in Buzen Province
藏品名称_ZN: 銅鏡（豊前国宇佐赤塚古墳出土）
描述_EN: Akatsuka Tomb is a 58-meter-long, front-circle, back-circle mound located on a plateau in Takamori, Usa City, Oita Prefecture, and was excavated in 1921. Five triangular-edged animals and animal mirrors, a pipe ball, and a fragment of an iron sword were found in the box-shaped sarcophagus in the center of the back circle, which was placed in an upright position. These triangular-edged animal and animal mirrors were made in China, making it one of the oldest burial mounds in Kyushu. The same mirrors have been found in the Ishitsuyama burial mound in Fukuoka Prefecture, the Tsubaki-Otsuyama burial mound in Kyoto Prefecture, and the Tsuno burial mound in Mie Prefecture, and their relationship has raised concerns.
描述_ZN: 赤冢墓是位于大分县宇佐市高森的高原上的一座长约58米的前圆后方的墓冢，于1921年发掘。在后圆中央的箱形石棺中发现了5个三角边的动物和动物镜、一个管球和一把铁剑碎片，该石棺被竖立放置。 这些三角形边框的动物和动物镜子都是在中国制造的，这使得它成为九州最古老的墓冢之一。 在福冈县的石津山墓冢、京都府的椿大津山墓冢和三重县的堤野墓冢中也发现了同样的镜子，它们之间的关系引起了人们的关注。

描述_EN: After the Ming Dynasty～end (of a period)、Southern China Kilns with White Magnetic and Dyeing Kilns in China、Colorful red, green, and blue tops of paintings in Japan, with the use of russet paintings.。The number of summoned items of Gosu Akagi Elegraph's plate is Kanari.、On the present case、There are a lot of products that can be matched with the Kirin text in the center of the view.、Representative Designs of Gusuku Akagaku and Speeches。recent year(s)、Research and Development in China、Kilns in Fujian Province are produced in the hittotsu area, which is clearly shown in the picture.。
描述_ZN: White porcelain and blue-and-white porcelain fired in southern China during the late Ming to late Ming periods and painted with red, blue, and green overglaze enameling are called gosu-aka-e in Japan. There are quite a few examples of Go-su-aka-e vessels in the history of Japan, especially those with a kylin design in the center of the front, as shown in this example. Recently, excavations in China have revealed that the kiln in Fujian Province was one of the production sites.

藏品名称_EN: Eight-sided eight-pronged mirror of Shuangpo Changtianhai ware
描述_EN: A sailing ship sails across the ocean, with dragons and fish peeking out from the waves. In addition to the octagonal mirrors, there are also round mirrors of several types, depending on the design and the presence or absence of the words "Huang Pi Chang Tian". They are found in the northern half of China, Korea and a wide area of Japan, and there are many examples of these mirrors in the Korean Peninsula. In Japan, it is enshrined in shrines of seafaring gods, such as Oyoshijima Shrine on Tsushima Island and Isozaki Shrine on Lake Biwa, probably due to the content of the design.
描述_ZN: 一艘帆船驶过海洋，龙和鱼从波浪中探出头来。 除了八角形的镜子外，还有圆形的镜子，根据设计和有无 "煌丕昌天 "字样，有几种类型。 它们分布在中国北半部、韩国和日本的广大地区，在朝鲜半岛有许多这种镜子的例子。 在日本，它被供奉在航海神的神社里，如对马岛的大吉岛神社和琵琶湖畔的矶崎神社，这可能是由于设计的内容所决定的。

描述_EN: Bronze mirrors from mainland China have traditionally included dragons in their designs, but slim double-dragon designs such as the one on this mirror have been found since the Liao Dynasty. Both the Jin state in northeastern China and Koryo on the Korean peninsula had mirrors of the same type with exactly the same design, both made of white bronze with a relatively high tin content, and most likely mass-produced by the same workshop in a short period of time.
描述_ZN: 中国大陆的铜镜设计中历来都有龙，但像这面镜子上的瘦身双龙设计，从辽代开始就出现了。 中国东北的金国和朝鲜半岛的高丽都有设计完全相同的同类型镜子，它们都是用锡含量相对较高的白铜制造的，而且极有可能是在短时间内由同一工场大量生产的。

描述_EN: A mirror with a bare frame, with the inner part made slightly higher. Although many plain mirrors were also found in China during the Song Dynasty (960-1279), the eight-flowered shape of mirrors such as this one is not known to be a mirror style unique to the Goryeo Dynasty. It may have been mass-produced for funerary purposes, especially since it is often found as a secondary burial object in tombs of this period.
描述_ZN: 一面裸框的镜子，内侧部分做得略高。 虽然中国在宋代（960-1279）也发现了许多素面镜，但像这面镜子的八花形并不出名，是高丽王朝特有的镜子风格。 它可能是为丧葬目的而大量生产的，特别是在这一时期的墓葬中经常发现它作为次要的随葬品。

描述_ZN: Among the many image mirrors produced in the Yangtze River basin around the 2nd and 3rd centuries, this is one of very few examples of its kind. The inscriptions on the figures in the inner section, "子胥," "wu王," and "越王," indicate that this mirror depicts a legend concerning the conflict between Wu and Yue at the end of the Spring and Autumn period. The expression of anger on the face and posture of Corporal Castle as he attempts to cut himself with the long sword in his hand against his neck are vividly expressed in the painting. After defeating Yue King Goujian, Wu Wang's wise advisor, Corporis Castle, advises Wu Wang to use this opportunity to kill his old enemy, but Wu Wang follows the advice of the dazai, who has been presented with beautiful women and treasures by Yue Wang, and spares Yue Wang's life. Later, King Wu, who believed the dazai's advice, ordered Wu Zis Castle to cut himself with the famous sword of the gensurau. Wu Zist胥, cursing the foolishness of King Wu, commits suicide and dies. The two women in the inner court were probably beautiful women presented by King Yue to King Wu's grand vizier, as the inscriptions "Two Yue Wangs" and "Two Jade Women" are found in the similar examples.

描述_EN: A tri-color dish from southern China, thought to have been fired at a kiln in Fujian Province, China, in the late Ming Dynasty. The lotus petal design on the exterior is molded and is a good example of the characteristics of South China Sancai wares, which make extensive use of the molding technique. There are many known South China Sancai plates, but plates with this lotus petal pattern on the outer surface are extremely rare.

描述_ZN: The bright green glaze is characteristic of this type, and the design is composed of floral arabesques on the body and lotus petals on the hips. This type of work is called Huanan sansai, and has been highly prized as a tea jar since the Edo period. Huanan sancai is the general term for lead-glazed ceramics made in southern China. It is also called koji sansai because it was thought to have originated in Kochi in northern Vietnam in ancient times. It was widely distributed in East Asia from the 16th to 17th centuries, and has been excavated from ruins in Southeast Asia as well as China and Japan.

描述_EN: A copy of the Forty-two Chapters Sutra (Daikaku Seonji, 1213-78) by Doyo Lanxi. The sutra contains forty-two precepts to be observed by Buddhist followers in their practice and daily life, and is highly valued in Zen Buddhism in China and Japan. In 1246, Lan Kwai Fong came to Japan from the Southern Song Dynasty and took refuge under Tokiyori Hojo, who became the founder of Kenchōji Temple. The influence of another Southern Song calligrapher, Zhang Jizhi (1186 - 1266), can be seen in his handwriting. A separate inscription indicates that it was given to a man named Shoutoku in July 1276.
描述_ZN: 兰溪道友抄写的四十二章经（Daikaku Seonji，1213-78）。 该经包含了佛教信徒在修行和日常生活中应遵守的四十二条戒律，在中国和日本的禅宗中受到高度重视。 1246年，兰桂坊从南宋来到日本，在北条时赖手下避难，成为建昌寺的创始人。 从他的笔迹中可以看出南宋另一位书法家张继之（1186 - 1266）的影响。 一个单独的铭文表明，它是在1276年7月送给一个叫Shoutoku的人。

描述_EN: A radical dictionary of Chinese characters compiled by King Goya of the Liang Dynasty in Southern China. This fragmentary scroll is on three sheets of paper, but it is a manuscript from the Tang Dynasty, and is the missing part of Volume IX of the National Treasure Tamahori in the collection of Waseda University. Since Tamahira was revised during the Song dynasty (960-1279), the manuscript from the Tang dynasty is of great value for studying the original form. The copy of Kōkai Shiki on the reverse side of the scroll, dated 121, indicates that the scroll was introduced to Japan in the mid-Heian period.
描述_ZN: 中国南朝梁王高雅编撰的激进的汉字字典。 这幅残卷虽然在三张纸上，但却是唐代的手稿，是早稻田大学收藏的国宝玉衡卷九中缺失的部分。 由于玉衡是在宋代（960-1279年）修订的，因此唐代的手稿对于研究原始形式具有重要价值。 卷轴反面的空海志副本，日期为121年，表明该卷轴是在平安时代中期传入日本的。

描述_EN: Bronze drums of the Majiang type used by the mountainous minorities of Guangxi and Guizhou provinces in southern China. Bronze drums are still played in rituals today. Imported as early as the Edo period, it was also known in Japan as "Zhuge Liang's campanile drum" and is apparently considered to be different from the ancient bronze drums of the Middle Kingdom. 描述_ZN: Lake Dongting and Red Cliff, known as one of China's most famous scenic spots since ancient times, are captured in a single view and depicted using the gold-blue-blue-green landscape painting technique. Many buildings, houses, and figures can be seen in this bird's-eye view of the landscape. From the inscription, it is clear that Ike Taiga (1723-76) was 49 years old when he created this representative work of his later years. This work has many titles and inscriptions, indicating that it was popular among the literati at the time of its creation. First, the title inscription was written by Han Tianshou, a well-known calligrapher and seal engraver, and the inscription "Tang-jin no ho" expresses his admiration for the authentic Tang dynasty-style blue-green landscapes. Next, the title "Qiankun niyoru bui" (Du Fu's "Tengyueyang Lou") by the Chinese scholar Miyazaki Gyunpo evokes the magnificent view of Lake Dongting from the Yueyang Lou. In addition, the rovings are by Hosogai Hansai, a Chinese scholar and poet, and Lai Chunsui, a Chinese scholar. From Hansai's afterword, we learn that this work was commissioned by Nishimura Mengqing, a member of the Chaosha, a Chinese poetry society in Osaka and a merchant, and that Taiga referred to Yang Jizeng's "Newly Chiseled Views of the Interior of the Sea" (published in 1609) when creating this work. Taiga's own praise is also taken from the same book. Chunsui's afterword praises the work as a work that allows the viewer to contemplate and play in the painting (lying down and playing) by comparing it to the scenic beauty of various countries he had experienced in the past. On the other hand, "Ejigoto hikigen" by Taiga's friend, Kuwayama Gyokusu, states that the "water pattern on the lake" in this work is excellent and new, and that Taiga's repeated trips to Lake Biwa to observe the shimmering water was used in its expression. The delicate expression of the water, expressed by the very thinly painted shades of deep blue and the fine lines of sumi ink drawn over them, is indeed a major characteristic of this work. Taiga was a keen student of imported Chinese paintings and frequently used them as references in his work, but it is important to note that he also placed great importance on observation of the actual scene, which is a fundamental aspect of his approach to art making. Nishimura Mengqing, who ordered this work, often performed it at poetry gatherings of the Chaosha, and Ge Ziqin left a poem inspired by this work. The existence of successors to this work by Taiga's disciples, such as "Lake Dotai" by Shukuya Aoki (Fukuoka City Museum of Art) and "Dotai Akakabe" by Gogaku Fukuhara (Osaka Museum of History), shows how widely the work was recognized and enjoyed.

描述_EN: A tray has a flat, wide base with a "brim" around the edge. The pattern consists of flowers, birds and augers (jiao), with the spaces between them filled with whorls resembling the shape of the word "no". Nearly ten cloisonné trays similar in shape, size, pattern composition and technique to this work have been found in Japan and are thought to have been produced in China during the Ming Dynasty and sold in East Asia. These cloisonné mask trays were often used as candy containers in Japanese tea ceremonies.

描述_EN: 94a) shows the secretary, under a mahogany-framed mirror, next to a crossbeam. plate xvii-n°2 by krafft and ransonnette (fig. the ornamentation and execution, on the other hand, are refined. The design is highly geometric: a sharp-edged parallelepiped with a square façade, punctuated by gilded bronze moldings and enhanced by a small plinth. like the bed, the secretary was part of madame recamier's bedroom furniture. the frames of the door and flap are highlighted with ebony and pewter fillets; a frieze of stars between two gilded bronze moldings, continuing along the sides, distinguishes the lower part from the upper part of the desk. the genies' wings were more folded and took up less space;the position of the legs was less plausible and the garland of flowers was prolonged instead of ending in ribbons. madame récamier kept her secretary, which can be found with the chest of drawers in her basse-du-rempart bedroom. the frieze of stars ran all the way around the lower section and, as with the bed, berthault lightened it. the door on the lower part reveals three English-style drawers. the differences between the project and its execution are minimal. On the flap, two genii, one knee on the ground, hold up a ribbon to support an entwined garland, reminiscent of the one on the bed; finally, four bees surround the keyhole. At the bottom, between two very linear flowers, a winged woman sits on a low stool, feet together, delicately holding a cord in front of an urn on a stele: this could be Psyche uncorking the flask entrusted to her by Persephone in the underworld, and the woman falls into a deep sleep as a result. The story of Psyche was already evoked in Madame Recamier's bedroom as a door overlay (and probably on the chest of drawers, visible in Berthault's designs), and we've already seen, in the case of the bed, a desire to link ornamentation to the themes of night and sleep. This is a small lady's secretary, whose flap, lined with red morocco, conceals three drawers, topped by three compartments. the decor is in harmony with the rest of the room: the stars, the garland, the long flowers on the base of the chinard statue. finally, the owner's initials, j.r., framed the lock.
描述_ZN: 94a）显示了秘书在红木框架的镜子下，在横梁的旁边。 KRAFFT和RANSONNETTE的第十七-N°2版（图）。 的装饰和执行，另一方面，也很精致。 该设计是高度几何化的：一个棱角分明的平行四边形，有一个正方形的立面，由镀金的青铜模子点缀，并由一个小基座加强。 和床一样，秘书也是雷玛尔夫人卧室家具的一部分。 门框和挡板上突出了乌木和锡制的花边；两个镀金的铜制模子之间的星星楣，沿着两侧延伸，将书桌的下部和上部区分开来。 年，精灵的翅膀更加折叠，所占空间更小；腿的位置不太合理，花环被延长而不是以丝带结束。 年，雷玛尔夫人保留了她的秘书，这与她在地下室的房间里的抽屉柜一起被发现。 年，星星的浮雕一直围绕着下部，和床一样，贝托尔把它照亮了。 下部的门显示了三个英式抽屉。 项目和执行之间的差异很小。 在挡板上，两个精灵，一个跪在地上，举着一条丝带，支撑着一个缠绕的花环，让人联想到床上的那个花环；最后，四只蜜蜂围绕着钥匙孔。 在底部，在两朵非常有线条感的花之间，一个长着翅膀的女人坐在一个低矮的凳子上，双脚并拢，在石碑上的骨灰盒前巧妙地拿着一根绳子：这可能是普西克在冥界打开珀尔塞福涅托付给她的酒壶，而这个女人因此陷入了沉睡。 在雷卡米尔夫人的卧室里，赛琪的故事已经作为门套被唤起了（可能还在抽屉柜上，在贝尔托尔的设计中可以看到），而且我们已经看到，在床的案例中，人们希望将装饰品与夜晚和睡眠的主题联系起来。 这是一个小型的女秘书，其翻盖上有红色摩洛哥的内衬，隐藏着三个抽屉，上面有三个隔层。 装饰与房间的其他部分相协调：星星、花环、奇纳德雕像底座上的长花。 最后，主人的姓名缩写j.r.镶在锁上。

描述_ZN: （绣线清乾隆书八征耄念之宝记）八征耄念之宝记。予年七十时用杜甫句。镌古稀天子之宝。而即继之曰。犹日孜孜。不敢怠于政也。蒙天眷佑。幸无大陨。越于兹又浃旬矣。思有所以。副八旬开袠之庆。镌为玺以殿诸御笔。盖莫若洪范八征之念。且予夙立愿八十有五。满乾隆六十年之数。即当归政。今虽八十。逮归政之岁尚有六年。一日未息。肩万民恒在怀。庶征之八可不念乎。念庶征即所以念万民。曲礼八十曰。耄老而智衰之谓。兹逮八十。幸赖天佑。身体康强。一日万几。未形智衰。不可不自勉也。如至果不能自勉。则亦不敢旷职以待六年之期。何则坛庙之祀。不可不躬亲。雨旸之时。不可不常验。中外之政。不可不日勤。民物之养。不可不心存。苟失其一。丛脞随之。则吾岂敢。是则耄而敬念庶征。仍古稀犹日孜孜之意也。亦五福五代堂之说。所谓皇极敛锡之志也。亦即近读洪范着论所谓六极中不能去其三。曰忧之义也。夫汉唐以来。古稀天子纔得六。六之中至八旬者纔得三。而三帝之中。惟元世祖可称贤。其二则予所鄙也。（三代下诸帝登七十者仅六见。予向所为古稀说。而六帝之中。惟梁武帝宋高宗元世祖年登八十。梁武帝自贻倾覆。宋高宗忘耻偷安。皆所素鄙。惟元世祖乃创业大有为之君。然践阼非早。建号仅三十五年。传孙成宗。其诸王世系元史虽无表可稽。但计其世次讫顺帝不过四传。亦不能如今五世同堂之盛。是则予之仰荷天眷。至为深厚。不特云稀。且自古所未有如是。而不祇承鸿贶爱养黎元。则予曷敢抑亦有所不忍也。）。即元世祖亦未如予之五代同堂。是予沐昊干鸿贶为独深。而予之所寅承锡羡当何如。亦曰体天爱民。诚心勤政。与洪范五之敛锡。八之念征。九之三忧。孜孜惕惕。日进无疆云尔。予之子孙能心予之心。政予之政。惕予之惕。忧予之忧。或得仰邀天眷有年。至七旬八旬者。继用此宝。则又我大清国亿万斯年无疆之庥。所不敢必而深愿者也。是为记。乾隆庚戌新正御笔。（绣印三）。向用五福。八征耄念之宝。自强不息。

The first volume of the Myoho-renge-kyo Sutra. Translated by Yao Qin Tripitaka Venerable Hatoma Rashi. The first preface of the Lotus Sutra. As I have heard. At that time, the Buddha lived in the Jaina Mountains in the king's shed city. He was with a great multitude of twenty thousand bhikkhus. All of them were arhats. All of them were arhats, and all of them were free from all omissions and worries. They have attained self-benefit and are free from all knots. The mind is at ease. Their name is Arhat. Mahakala. Urobindra Kaya. Gayatri Kaya. Natyagarbha. Shariputra. Mahamudra. Mahārāja Chandra. Athullukhya. Robinson. Marriage of Vaibhuti. Vairocana. Bhringa Prabhupāda. Bhagavad-gītā. Mahāyāna. Nandha. Sundara Nandha. Fulunamitra Niko. Suddhodana. Ananda. Rahula. These are the great arhats and others who are known to all. There are two thousand learned and unlearned. Mahabharata Bhikkhuni. With six thousand dependents. Yehudra Bhikkhuni, the mother of Rāhula. Also with their dependents. Bodhisattva Mahasattva 80,000. All of them do not retreat from Avalokiteshvara. All have attained dharmakaya and are happy to speak eloquently. Turning the wheel of non-returning dharma. They make offerings to hundreds and thousands of Buddhas. Planting all virtues in all the Buddhas. To be praised by all Buddhas. To cultivate the body with compassion and to enter the Buddha's wisdom. To attain great wisdom and reach the other shore. The name of the Buddha is universally known in all the worlds. He is capable of taming hundreds of thousands of sentient beings. His name is Manjushri Bodhisattva. Guanyin Bodhisattva. 牛能画野人壁。苜蓿不满先生盘。闭门痴坐晚花静。搔首独吟江阁寒。满地烟波如此阔。明朝吾欲把渔竿。湖上有田方辍耕。湖头水生浑欲平。白发青衫苦多事。痴风黠雨难为情。钩帘慎勿惊凫鸭。洗眼独来看决明。几欲出门呼杖屦。街头泥滑未能行。（第十七则）苦热。六月火云烂。蒸人何可当。摊书风叶底。飞梦雪山傍。朱鸟翚南极。丹葵傲北土啬。衰残无臂力。弊扇不能扬。（第十八则）观梅于陶东谷所三首。庚辰之春黄洲。（之一）海上春来苦较迟。梅花二月始垂垂。寒香尚带氷霜意。玉骨应销粉黛姿。白发看花非杀景。芳辰对酒且题诗。壶中更喜长春在。遮莫邻家篴漫吹。（之二）天留玉色照深春。隔水踈花斩斩新。不为风霜趋暖地。敢同儿女媚芳辰。繁阴过眼悬佳实。故国凭谁寄远人。且赏陶家风味别。巡檐莫笑雪中真。（之三）江梅二月始花开。春意还从雪后来。溪上风烟犹澹薄。门前车马自尘埃。吟成东阁月初上。梦到西湖鹤未回。几欲杖藜时索笑。不妨随意踏苍苔。（第十九则）嘲陶东谷乐水歌。龙山史。渊明高兴真翩然。朝来饯别临江边。留连不及玉瓶倒。芙蓉含吹臙脂老。客去秋空烟水茫。离情已逐寒云杳。回舟恰欲向城市。翻身失脚迷阴道。半浸秋波动碧天。不似知章井底眠。乳凫不惊鱼藻乱。舴艋仍在尊罍颠。总为婺州三百瓮。未了平生缘。河伯忙拥卫。伏妃走相牵。岂为苍生试水利。凌波直欲探龙渊。渔翁跃（点去）濯足沧浪烟。半倚木兰笑谪仙。忙予为作登高延。摇手拒户莫肯前。作歌聊为谢知旧。遥闻动马卿怜。（此句当有脱字）。（第二十则）性情集。余为江湖名胜留芳馥。集成。遍淮浙间。都随舟车至广东西郡。且及琼崖。尚风雅者。如易鸡林。一行作吏。此事遂废。梓刻阁尘埃三十年。余老矣。卸此责。无谁语。顷来雅欲属贵峰。贵峰志锐。亦不减余初志。诗运迁回。可一摅此抱。昔和凝着香奁集。是时凝在政府。避物论。讳人知己。因嫁名于韩渥。（当作偓）。余之从臾贵峰。非避物论嫁名也。贵峰识鉴晶明。司诗衡迈余远甚。将见如孙翼撰正商集。为集之穷者。非特一刘庭芝。可得千万刘庭芝。林梅癯景祥。（第二十一则）题仕女。鹤坡。万花丛里曲阑东。拾得秋风一叶红。传与仙郎报消息。彩云只在月明中。

描述_EN: 'contained box' looks at ideas of containment, and a balance and layering of materials. andrea walsh (b.1974) studied fine art at staffordshire university before completing her ma in glass at edinburgh college of art. intimately scaled, the work evokes a sense of preciousness and value, with the translucent glass box inviting the viewer to investigate what lies within. it marked a progression from walsh's earlier delicate box forms with cast glass lids, of which the v&a holds two in its collection (c.127-2012 and c.128-2012). she has since incorporated ceramics into her practice, exploring the complimentary qualities of fine bone china and glass. this piece was the first in a new collection of works that developed the theme of boxes and vessels within walsh's work, and was exhibited at collect open 2015 in london.
描述_ZN: '包含的盒子'关注的是包含的概念，以及材料的平衡和分层。 ANDREA WALSH（1974年出生）在斯塔福德郡大学学习美术，然后在爱丁堡艺术学院完成了她的玻璃专业硕士学位。 亲密的比例，作品唤起了一种珍贵和价值的感觉，半透明的玻璃盒子邀请观众去研究里面的东西。 它标志着沃尔什早期带有铸造玻璃盖子的精致盒子形式的进步，V&A在其收藏中拥有两个盒子（c.127-2012和c.128-2012）。 她将陶瓷融入到她的实践中，探索精细骨瓷和玻璃的互补性。 这件作品是Walsh作品中发展盒子和容器主题的新作品系列中的第一件，并在2015年伦敦的Collect open上展出。

描述_EN: the partnership have designed ceramics for major producers and retailers around the globe. queensberry hunt are the leading uk ceramic design practice of the post-war period. these include wedgwood, hornsea, rosenthal, habitat, crate and barrel, john lewis and jamie oliver. their practice spans a period of immense change in the industry, brought about by the adoption of new technologies, and the shift in production towards east asia. formed in 1966 by david queensberry, then professor of ceramics at the rca, and his former student martin hunt. working in an essentially modernist aesthetic, queensberry hunt have been responsible for some of the most familiar and best-selling tableware of recent decades.
描述_ZN: 该伙伴关系为全球主要生产商和零售商设计陶瓷。 昆斯伯里-亨特是战后英国领先的陶瓷设计机构。 其中包括Wedgwood、Hornsea、Rosenthal、Habitat、Crate and Barrel、John Lewis和Jamie oliver。 他们的实践跨越了行业的巨大变化时期，由新技术的采用和生产向东亚的转移所带来的。 由David queensberry和他以前的学生Martin hunt于1966年成立，后者当时是RCA的陶瓷学教授。 在本质上的现代主义美学中工作，Queensberry Hunt负责近几十年来一些最熟悉和最畅销的餐具的制作。

描述_EN: imperial robe of silk tapestry (kesi), woven in coloured silks and gold thread; some of the details have been executed with the brush. the collar and sleeves have bands of dragon designs on a fretted ground. lined with light blue silk damask. the lower border and sleeves are encircled with a striped pattern culminating in waves on which symbolical objects are floating. woven with medallions containing five-clawed dragons pursuing or grasping flaming jewels, the intervening space is covered with gold swastika fret overlaid with flying storks and bats, sprays of flowers and scrolled clouds.
描述_ZN: imperial robe of silk tapestry (kesi), woven in coloured silks and gold thread; some of the details have been executed with the brush. 领子和袖子上有带状的龙形图案，以花纹为底。 内衬为浅蓝色丝绸绫罗绸缎。 下边框和袖子上环绕着条纹图案，最后是象征性物体漂浮在上面的波浪。 织有五爪龙追赶或抓取火焰珠宝的徽章，中间的空间覆盖着金色的卍字纹，上面覆盖着飞翔的鹳鸟和蝙蝠、花束和卷云。

描述_EN: a production of one of the imperial looms; intended to be worn by the emperor or a prince of the blood. the design presents a medley of confucian, buddhist and daoist symbolism. density 60x90 threads/sq.cm, cross- sectional width of warp 0.1mm, of weft 0.2mm. confucianism is symbolized by the battle-axe and the pair of sacrificial wine-cups. three five-clawed dragons rise from the waves of the sea, encircled by clouds. the upper dragon represented full-face is coiled round a cosmic medallion with the shou (longevity) character in the centre surrounded by the hanging musical stone, the peach, bat and magic fungus, the attributes of the eight daoist immortals and other emblens as signs of long life and felicity. back of a robe of silk tapestry (kesi), woven in coloured silks and gold thread on a yellow ground. the pair of dragons below grasp the flaming jewel of the buddhist law. the cloud spaces are filled in with diverse forms of the shou character, flying bats, jewelled sceptres and floral sprays.
描述_ZN: a production of one of the imperial looms; intended to be worn by the emperor or a prince of the blood. 该设计呈现了儒家、佛教和道家的混合象征。 密度60x90线/平方厘米，经线截面宽度0.1mm，纬线截面宽度0.2mm。 儒家的象征是斧头和一对祭祀用的酒杯。 三条五爪龙从大海的波浪中升起，被云层包围着。 上层的龙正面盘绕着一个宇宙徽章，中心是寿字，周围是悬铃木、桃子、蝙蝠、魔耳、八仙的属性以及其他象征长寿和幸福的徽章。 丝织品长袍的背面，由彩色丝绸和金线在黄地上编织而成。 下面的一对龙抓住了佛法的火焰宝珠。 云层中充满了各种形式的寿字、飞蝠、宝杖和花草。

描述_EN: posters helped to propagate the cult and here he is seen literally as the central subject. mao zedong's personal aim behind the cultural revolution was to bolster his own position within the communist party. chairman mao badges and posters offered a means for people to 'own' the cult and demonstrate their allegiance. a 'saturation campaign' of visual propaganda was a primary vehicle for disseminating the new ideologies. through the upheaval of the cultural revolution (1966-1976) mao zedong aimed to reinvigorate communism in china and eliminate traditional urban class differences. themes and form were rigidly prescribed and the idealised figures were often copied from source books.
描述_ZN: 海报帮助宣传邪教，在这里他被看作是中心主题。 毛泽东在文化革命背后的个人目的是为了加强他自己在共产党内的地位。 毛主席徽章和海报为人们提供了一种 "拥有 "邪教并展示其忠诚的方式。 视觉宣传的 "饱和运动 "是传播新意识形态的主要工具。 通过文化大革命（1966-1976）的动荡，毛泽东旨在重振中国的共产主义，消除传统的城市阶级差异。 主题和形式是严格规定的，理想化的人物往往是从原始书籍中复制的。

描述_EN: it is practised by people from various groups living in the south-west of china. because they live in comparative isolation in mountainous regions, these groups have developed some unique traditions. the technique used here is wax resist, similar to indonesian batik. these indigo wax-resist textiles are one distinctive manifestation of their culture.
描述_ZN: 它是由生活在中国西南部的不同群体的人所实行的。 由于他们生活在相对孤立的山区，这些群体已经发展了一些独特的传统。 这里使用的技术是蜡质抗蚀剂，类似于印度尼西亚的蜡染。 这些靛蓝蜡质的纺织品是他们文化的一种独特表现。

描述_EN: lacquer workers quickly realised the decorative potential of the material and sometimes painted patterns on the lacquered surface. lacquer is a waterproof varnish made from the sap of the tree rhus vernicifera. this dish is an example of the usually plain lacquered wares produced in china during the sophisticated song dynasty (960-1279). the chinese began to use it to provide a protective coating for wooden and bamboo bowls at least 3000 years ago.
描述_ZN: 漆器工人很快意识到了这种材料的装饰潜力，有时会在漆器表面绘制图案。 漆是一种防水的清漆，是由树的汁液制成的，它是由Rhus vernicifera制成的。 这个盘子是在复杂的宋代（960-1279）期间在中国生产的通常是普通漆器的例子。 中国人至少在3000年前就开始用它来为木碗和竹碗提供保护层。

描述_EN: from surviving mamluk textiles, it seems that blue was a favoured colour. similar textiles have not been found in china and it is possible that these silks were made specially for the mamluk empire (1250-1517). mamluk and other textiles from the islamic world are known to incorporate scripts into their designs, so the inclusion of a longevity ideograph may have been a deliberate move. there are stitch holes along the selvedge while opposite there are remains of stitches in red silk. a small piece of linen cloth (unbleached) is attached to one edge. this is contained within a circle around which are curly cloud shapes. this fragment of silk damask have a pattern in blue on a yellow ground showing a simplified chinese symbol resembling the shou character for longevity. the weaving may have been carried out in china and the silks then exported westwards, or it could have been done outside china by islamic craftsmen familiar with chinese patterning.
描述_ZN: 从现存的马穆鲁克纺织品来看，蓝色似乎是一种受欢迎的颜色。 类似的纺织品在中国没有发现，这些丝绸有可能是专门为马穆鲁克帝国（1250-1517）制作的。 马穆鲁克和其他来自伊斯兰世界的纺织品都知道将文字纳入他们的设计中，所以加入一个长寿的表意文字可能是一个有意的举动。 沿边有针孔，而对面有红绸的针脚残留。 一小块亚麻布（未漂白）连接在一个边缘。 这个图案包含在一个圆圈内，圆圈周围是卷曲的云朵形状。 这块丝绸绫罗绸缎上有一个黄底蓝字的图案，显示了一个简化的中国符号，类似于长寿的寿字。 织造可能是在中国进行的，然后丝绸向西出口，也可能是在中国以外由熟悉中国图案的伊斯兰工匠完成。

描述_EN: when wound up this tin plate goldfish moves on two centre wheels connected to the clockwork mechanism. as the toy moves, the side fins open and close and the tail fin, governed by the wheel, moves from one side to the other. there is a third wheel also connected to the mechanism which extends to form the pin for the tail fin. this is actually an erratic movement and not just a swaying one. the whole fish moves one way, pauses then moves the other way. the breeding of goldfish in china has a long history and breeders have always attempted to create very large eyes as in this toy example.
描述_ZN: 当上弦时，这只锡板金鱼在两个中心轮子上移动，与发条机制相连。 随着玩具的移动，侧边的鳍打开和关闭，尾鳍在轮子的支配下从一边移动到另一边。 有一个第三个轮子也连接到机制上，它延伸形成尾鳍的针。 这实际上是一种不稳定的运动，而不仅仅是一种摇摆。 整条鱼向一个方向移动，停顿然后向另一个方向移动。 中国金鱼的繁殖有很长的历史，繁殖者总是试图创造非常大的眼睛，就像这个玩具的例子一样。

描述_EN: the meeting of the two is depicted in a landscape with a willow-trees; in the distance mountains and the elaborate roof of a pavilion wreathed in clouds. as he returned home he met a woman who offered herself as his wife. at the top is tung yung who lived about ad 200. hanging panel of embroidered red satin in coloured silks (mostly green, blue, black and white, with touches of red, pink and yellow), and silver-gilt thread in satin and stem stitches and laid and couched work. then, after revealing that she was the star chih nu, sent by the lord of heaven to reward him for his filial conduct, she vanished from sight. he was so poor that when his father died he could not pay the fees for the funeral rites, so he sold himself as a bond servant on the loan of ten thousand cash with which he paid for the rites. he is shown standing by the couch, fan in hand, his father appears to the left. below is huang hiang who was left motherless when he was only seven years old and thence-forward devoted himself to the care of his father, fanning him all through the summer nights, and in winter lying down first on his father's couch to warm it with his own body. embroidered with two of the stories of filial piety. lined with pink cotton. during the month that she lived with him, she wove for him three hundred webs of silk, with the proceeds of which he was able to repay the loan and redeem himself.
描述_ZN: the meeting of the two is depicted in a landscape with a willow-trees; in the distance mountains and the elaborate roof of a pavilion wreathed in clouds. 当他回到家时，遇到了一个女人，她主动提出做他的妻子。 顶端的是生活在公元200年左右的董永。 挂板，用彩色丝绸（主要是绿色、蓝色、黑色和白色，也有红色、粉色和黄色的点缀）绣红缎，用银鎏金线绣缎子和茎针，以及铺设和耦合工作。 然后，在透露了她是天主派来奖励他的孝顺行为的赤兔星后，她就消失了。 他很穷，当他的父亲去世时，他无法支付葬礼的费用，所以他把自己卖了，作为一个债券仆人，借了一万块钱的现金，用来支付仪式。 他站在沙发边，手里拿着扇子，他的父亲出现在左边。 下面是黄香，他在七岁的时候就失去了母亲，从那时起就致力于照顾他的父亲，在夏天的夜晚为他扇风，在冬天先躺在他父亲的沙发上，用自己的身体温暖他。 绣有两个孝道的故事。 用粉红色的棉布做衬里。 在她与他同居的一个月里，她为他织了三百张丝网，他用这些丝网的收入偿还了贷款并赎回了自己。

描述_EN: from surviving mamluk textiles, it seems that blue was a favoured colour. similar textiles have not been found in china and it is possible that these silks were made specially for the mamluk empire (1250-1517). the staining may be due to their having been buried, although no archeological report exist. this fragment is part of a group of chinese silks in the v&a collection , broadly dated between the late thirteenth century and the mid-fifteenth century. the weaving may have been carried out in china and the silks then exported westwards, or it could have been done outside china by islamic craftsmen familiar with chinese patterning. mamluk and other textiles from the islamic world are known to incorporate scripts into their designs.
描述_ZN: 从现存的马穆鲁克纺织品来看，蓝色似乎是一种受欢迎的颜色。 类似的纺织品在中国没有发现，这些丝绸有可能是专门为马穆鲁克帝国（1250-1517）制作的。 染色可能是由于他们被埋葬了，虽然没有考古报告。 这块碎片是V&A收藏的一组中国丝绸的一部分，时间大致在13世纪末到15世纪中叶。 织造可能是在中国进行的，然后丝绸向西出口，也可能是在中国以外由熟悉中国图案的伊斯兰工匠完成。 众所周知，马姆鲁克和伊斯兰世界的其他纺织品在设计中都加入了文字。

描述_EN: it is similar to yaozhou ware in its carved floral design and glaze-type, but its body is coarser, and its glaze is tinged a yellow hue, instead of the olive green common to yaozhou ware. the firing method at xunyi is also unlike that of yaozhou, and is revealed by the unglazed circle at the centre of the dish. a common space and money saving measure was to fire dishes in stacks, leaving behind an unglazed ring where the base of the dish above would have rested. during the jin dynasty (1115-1234), the xunyi kilns made wares in imitation of the widely popular yaozhou wares that were made only 70 kilometers away. this dish is an example of the ceramics made at the kilns of xunyi in the shaanxi province of china.
描述_ZN: 它的雕花图案和釉色类型与耀州器相似，但它的器身更粗，其釉色为黄色，而不是耀州器常见的橄榄绿。 旬邑的烧制方法也与耀州不同，从盘子中心的未上釉的圆圈可以看出。 一个常见的节省空间和金钱的措施是把盘子堆在一起烧，留下一个未上釉的环，上面的盘子的底部会放在那里。 在金代（1115-1234），旬邑窑模仿70公里外广为流行的耀州瓷器而制作的。 这个盘子是中国陕西省旬邑窑制造的陶瓷的一个例子。

描述_EN: ding wares were often fired upside down, a strategy that served to spread the weight of the object onto the rim, guarding against any malformation of their thinly potted bodies during the firing. ding ware was a highly sought-after style of porcelain made in the ding kilns of the hebei province, that reached their height of popularity during the northern song (960-1127) and jin (1115-1234) dynasties. ding wares were of the earliest true porcelains made in china, and were known for their bright white bodies, impermeability and fine texture. while it displays the ding ware characteristics of a white colour and a decorative metal rim, its firing method reveals it as an imitation. they were produced as ‘official wares’ for use at court, and were highly esteemed throughout china. this dish was fired by a different method, evident from the spur marks at its centre (small imprints from the stand it rested on in the kiln), revealing it as an imitation of ding ware. this left behind an unglazed area at the rim, which was often hidden by a metal covering. this naturally resulted in the production of many imitations, including this dish (front left of image) from the haozhou kilns in the shanxi province.
描述_ZN: 鼎器通常是倒着烧的，这种策略是为了将器物的重量分散到边缘上，防止其薄薄的壶身在烧制过程中出现任何畸形。 定窑是河北省定窑制造的一种非常受欢迎的瓷器风格，在北宋（960-1127）和金（1115-1234）时期达到了鼎盛。 定窑是中国最早的真正意义上的瓷器，以其亮白的瓷体、不透水和精细的质地而闻名。 虽然它显示了白色和金属边缘装饰的鼎器特征，但它的烧制方法显示了它是一个仿制品。 它们是作为宫廷用的 "官器 "而生产的，在中国各地受到高度尊重。 这个盘子是用不同的方法烧制的，从它中心的刺痕（它在窑里的支架上留下的小印记）可以看出，它是一个仿丁器的产品。 这在边缘留下了一个未上釉的区域，它通常被一个金属罩子所隐藏。 这自然导致了许多仿制品的产生，包括这个来自山西省濠州窑的盘子（图片左前方）。

描述_EN: the garment is reversible. it is lined with a silk chiffon, the same weight as the patterned 'outside' but in plain lilac. exemplifying the shanghai tang touch, a plain chiffon fastening is sewn on the patterned side, and a patterned one is sewn on the plain 'inside'. in this position it serves more as discreet decoration than as a practical fastening although a similar knot and loop secures the garment at the back of the neck. this top is teamed with a matching pair of trousers. a loop and knot fastening is used here at the side of a woman's summer top. this non-traditional use of a traditional closure is typical of the clothese made by shanghai tang, the brainchild of the hong kong entrepreneur david tang.
描述_ZN: 该服装是可翻转的。 它的内衬是丝质雪纺，与外面的图案重量相同，但是是纯淡紫色的。 体现了上海滩的风格，在有图案的一面缝有普通的雪纺扣，而在普通的 "里面 "缝有图案的扣。 在这个位置，它更多的是作为谨慎的装饰，而不是作为一个实用的扣件，尽管类似的结和环将衣服固定在脖子后面。 这件上衣与一条相配的长裤搭配在一起。 这里的环形和结扣是用在女性夏季上衣的侧面。 这种对传统开襟的非传统使用是上海滩的典型服装，上海滩是香港企业家David Tang的创意之作。

描述_ZN: 动物医院的玩具系列与小狗在我的口袋里一起推出，这是一个成功的微型玩具系列。 动物医院是英国广播公司的一个受欢迎的系列节目，持续了10年。 该节目由罗夫-哈里斯主持，他跟随兽医在RSPCA救援中心的日常工作。 该系列玩具的部分收入将捐给RSPCA，以帮助他们继续开展与动物有关的良好工作。 其他主持人报道了来自全国各地甚至全世界的动物故事。 最后一个系列是在2002年播出的。

描述_EN: star wars: a new hope was released in 1977. sequels released in 1980 and 1983 were equally successful. the first film of george lucas' trilogies was the most successful in american history and grossed over $290 million. a whole host of toy figures, spacecrafts and toy guns were available, as well as costumes, stationery, bedroom accessories and slippers. this figure is made as part of the 1999 film release, 'star wars episode 1: the phantom menace'. the films captured their imagination and paved the way for the merchandising that accompanies many films today.
描述_ZN: 《星球大战：新希望》于1977年上映。 1980年和1983年发行的续集同样成功。 乔治-卢卡斯的三部曲中的第一部电影是美国历史上最成功的，总票房超过2.9亿美元。 一大堆的玩具人物、太空飞船和玩具枪，以及服装、文具、卧室配件和拖鞋。 这个人物是作为1999年发行的电影《星球大战第一集：幽灵的威胁》的一部分制作的。 这些电影抓住了他们的想象力，为今天许多电影的商品销售铺平了道路。

描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. part of the v&a british design season. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. this item is part of one of the "punk lolita" outfits ( h.naoto) on display from 23 april 2012 to 27 january 2013 in the "kitty and the bulldog lolita fashion and the influence of britain" display at the v&a. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 是V&A英国设计季的一部分。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 这个项目是2012年4月23日至2013年1月27日在V&A的 "KITTY AND THE BULDOG LOLITA时尚和英国的影响 "展览中展出的 "朋克洛丽塔 "服装之一（H.NAOTO）的一部分。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_EN: in the night garden is a popular children's television series shown on cbeebies featuring a range of colourful characters who care deeply for one another. igglepiggle is one of the main characters and takes the form of a blue, teddy-like toy. blanket time igglepiggle can sing, dance, and play games, all of which are designed to revolve around his red blanket. in the programme he is always seen carrying his red blanket, which is reflected in this interactive soft toy, made by hasbro in 2007.
描述_ZN: 《夜花园》是一个流行的儿童电视系列节目，在Cbeebies上播放，其中有一系列色彩斑斓的人物，他们彼此之间相互关心。 igglepiggle是主要人物之一，外形是一个蓝色的、类似泰迪的玩具。 毯子时间igglepiggle可以唱歌、跳舞和玩游戏，所有这些都是围绕他的红色毯子而设计的。 在节目中，他总是带着他的红色毛毯，这也反映在这个互动的软玩具中，由hasbro在2007年制作。

描述_EN: episode 2: attack of the clones is a 2002 space opera film directed by george lucas. star wars: a new hope was released in 1977. sequels released in 1980 and 1983 were equally successful. it was released on may 16th of that year and was set ten years after the previous film, the phantom menace. the first film of george lucas' trilogies was the most successful in american history and grossed over $290 million. a whole host of toy figures, spacecrafts and toy guns were available, as well as costumes, stationery, bedroom accessories and slippers. in attack of the clones, padmé amidala becomes a senator from the planet naboo, showing that she has grown since her time as queen. the films captured their imagination and paved the way for the merchandising that accompanies many films today.
描述_ZN: 《第二集：克隆人的进攻》是一部2002年的太空歌剧电影，由乔治-卢卡斯导演。 《星球大战：新希望》于1977年上映。 1980年和1983年发行的续集同样成功。 该片于当年5月16日上映，背景是前一部电影《幽灵的威胁》的十年后。 乔治-卢卡斯的三部曲中的第一部电影是美国历史上最成功的，总票房超过2.9亿美元。 一大堆的玩具人物、太空飞船和玩具枪，以及服装、文具、卧室配件和拖鞋。 在《克隆人的进攻》中，帕德梅-阿米达拉成为纳布星球的参议员，表明她在成为女王之后已经成长。 这些电影抓住了他们的想象力，为今天许多电影的商品销售铺平了道路。

描述_EN: the buildings in the photographs are sales models made by real-estate developers, but xing danwen digitally inserts herself into the images, adopting different personae and creating unsettling narratives. this photograph expresses danwen's personal feelings of urban life in china today – that it can be lonely, psychologically distant and devoid of a sense of reality. the photograph was shown in the v&a exhibition and touring show china design now, the first major exhibition in the uk on new chinese design that has emerged over the last two decades..
描述_ZN: 照片中的建筑是由房地产开发商制作的销售模型，但邢丹文以数字方式将自己插入图像中，采用不同的角色，创造出令人不安的叙述。 这张照片表达了Danwen对当今中国城市生活的个人感受--它可能是孤独的，心理上遥远的，没有现实感的。 这张照片在V&A展览和巡回展中国设计中展出，这是英国第一个关于过去20年中出现的新中国设计的大型展览。

描述_EN: when the teddy bear craze took off in the states in 1906, the soft toys became commonly known as teddy bears. his refusal to shoot a captured bear cub in november 1902 was made famous through a political cartoon by clifford berryman in the washington post newspaper. the teddy bear gets its name from theodore ‘teddy’ roosevelt, president of the united states. the endearing cartoon bear became associated with the president. this bear was produced as a special edition for the charity, good bears of the world, and marks the centenary of president roosevelt’s association with the teddy bear.
描述_ZN: 1906年，当泰迪熊的热潮在美国掀起时，这种软体玩具被普遍称为泰迪熊。 他在1902年11月拒绝射杀一只被捕获的小熊，通过Clifford Berryman在Washington Post报纸上的一幅政治漫画而成名。 泰迪熊的名字来自美国总统Theodore 'Teddy' Roosevelt。 这只可爱的卡通熊开始与总统联系在一起。 这只熊是为慈善机构Good bears of the world制作的特别版，标志着罗斯福总统与泰迪熊的关系达到了百年。

描述_ZN: meomi design是由Vicky wong和Michael murphy组成的二人组，他们是插画师、动画师和设计师，曾为儿童制作书籍和电视系列。 Muk Muk是2010年温哥华冬奥会的 "官方伙伴"。 三个官方吉祥物是大脚野人Quatchi、海熊Miga和奇美拉Sumi。 它是一只旱獭，一种原产于赛事举办地的濒危物种。 温哥华2010年商品的生产和发布是分阶段的，最初Muk Muk只存在于网上，但他很快就被生产成了毛绒玩具。 这三个都是根据加拿大土著文化的传说设计的，但其他影响包括奥运会和残奥会运动、现代动画风格以及英属哥伦比亚和加拿大的文化和野生动物。

描述_EN: since then his reports have been seen around the world and his commercial clients include such names as chanel, dior, vogue, harper’s bazaar, harrods and l’oréal. david downton graduated from the university of wolverhampton and began his career as a general illustrator in brighton in 1984. whilst he occasionally did fashion illustrations, it was not until 1996 when he was sent to the couture shows by the financial times that he became known as a fashion illustrator. although such deconstruction looks spontaneous, it takes dozens of drawings on layout paper to achieve a successful result. his work is distinguished by its deliberate omissions, where he draws a subject and then begins to remove details and elements until only the barest minimum remains. in 2007 he launched pourquoi pas?, the first journal to be dedicated to fashion illustration.
描述_ZN: 从那时起，他的报告在世界各地被看到，他的商业客户包括香奈儿、迪奥、《Vogue》、《Harper's bazaar》、哈罗德和欧莱雅等名字。 大卫-唐顿毕业于沃尔弗汉普顿大学，1984年在布莱顿开始了他的职业生涯，成为一名普通的插画师。 虽然他偶尔也做时尚插画，但直到1996年他被《金融时报》派去参加高级时装秀时，他才以时尚插画师的身份为人所知。 虽然这样的解构看起来是自发的，但它需要在排版纸上画几十张才能达到一个成功的结果。 他的作品以其故意的省略而闻名，他画了一个主题，然后开始删除细节和元素，直到只剩下最基本的东西。 在2007年，他推出了pourquoi pas？，第一个致力于时尚插画的杂志。

描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_EN: fuseproject has worked with herman miller, puma, swarovski, danese, bmw mini and coca cola. the fuseproject agency was founded by yves béhar in san francisco in 1999. the xo laptop is designed to operate as part of a communal open network allowing the distribution of knowledge and learning through open-source applications and software. the xo laptop is designed as part of the one laptop per child (olpc) initiative, a non-profit organisation created by mit professor nicholas negroponte in 2002. the xo was designed to withstand varying weather and environmental conditions, with no hard drive and only two internal cables as research by fuseproject, the design partner appointed by olpc, found that these were the two elements most likely to fail. béhar was born in switzerland and was educated in europe and in the us. the laptops have wi-fi antenna that are three times as powerful as a standard laptop and can create a mesh network where if one laptop is connected to a network, all others nearby can connect to this first laptop and share this network too. the laptops can run on both linux and windows xp operating systems. the following year he was appointed chair of the industrial design programme at the california college of the arts, a position he currently holds. the screen pivots around so that the laptop can be used as an ebook reader, while the keyboard is a single rubberised sheet to prevent dust and water entering, with smaller keys than a normal keyboard, again designed for children. his work was featured in monographic exhibitions at the san francisco museum of modern art and the museé de design et d’arts appliqués contemporains in lausanne in 2004. the casing has two green 'ears' that act as wi-fi antennae, appealing to children, and a rechargeable battery provides up to 22.8 watt-hours.
描述_ZN: fuseproject曾与赫尔曼-米勒、彪马、施华洛世奇、丹尼斯、宝马迷你和可口可乐合作。 Fuseproject机构由Yves Béhar于1999年在旧金山创立。 XO笔记本电脑被设计成作为公共开放网络的一部分，允许通过开源的应用程序和软件分发知识和学习。 XO笔记本是作为每个孩子一台笔记本（OLPC）倡议的一部分而设计的，这是一个由麻省理工学院教授尼古拉斯-尼葛洛庞帝在2002年创建的非营利组织。 XO的设计能够承受不同的天气和环境条件，没有硬盘，只有两条内部电缆，因为Olpc指定的设计合作伙伴fuseproject的研究发现，这两个元素最容易发生故障。 贝哈尔出生在瑞士，在欧洲和美国接受教育。 笔记本电脑的Wi-Fi天线是标准笔记本电脑的三倍，并且可以创建一个网状网络，如果一台笔记本电脑连接到一个网络，附近所有其他的笔记本电脑也可以连接到这第一台笔记本电脑并分享这个网络。 笔记本电脑可以在Linux和Windows XP操作系统上运行。 次年，他被任命为加州艺术学院工业设计课程的主席，他目前担任这一职务。 屏幕可以旋转，这样笔记本就可以作为电子书阅读器使用，而键盘是一块橡胶板，防止灰尘和水进入，按键比普通键盘小，也是为儿童设计的。 他的作品在2004年在旧金山现代艺术博物馆和洛桑设计与应用艺术博物馆的专题展览中展出。 外壳有两个绿色的 "耳朵"，作为Wi-Fi天线，对儿童很有吸引力，可充电电池提供22.8瓦时。

描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_EN: a print of such large scale, with even and perfect tonal effects, represents a high level of technical accomplishment. water symbolises simplicity, memory and human virtues. water is a time-honoured image in chinese art and philosophy, but is rarely the main subject of chinese works of art.images of water pervade ancient chinese culture. in this large woodblock, chen qi departs from convention by devoting the entire artwork to the theme of water, and the work becomes a piece of abstract contemplation.this woodblock print invites the viewer to contemplate the abstract qualities of water.
描述_ZN: 如此大规模的印刷品，具有均匀完美的色调效果，代表了高水准的技术成就。 水象征着简单、记忆和人类的美德。 水在中国艺术和哲学中是一个历史悠久的形象，但很少是中国艺术作品的主要主题，水的形象充斥着中国古代文化。 在这幅大型木版画中，陈琦打破常规，将整幅作品用于水的主题，作品成为一幅抽象的沉思作品。

描述_EN: gold and silver were not as highly coveted in china as in other ancient civilisations such as the roman or the parthian, but they came to play a more central role in chinese society by the beginning of the tang dynasty (ad 618-907) when frequent trade contacts between china and its western neighbours developed along the silk road. this cup was probably used to drink alcohol and clearly shows how foreign shapes were imitated during the tang dynasty. chinese goldsmiths often imitated the foreign shapes and styles of the imported goods and developed new techniques under the influence of central asian craftsmen who had settled in chinese urban centers beginning in the mid 7th century.
描述_ZN: 在中国，金银并不像其他古代文明如罗马或帕提亚那样受到高度重视，但到了唐朝（公元618-907年）开始，它们在中国社会中发挥了更重要的作用，当时中国和西方邻国之间的贸易往来沿着丝绸之路频繁发展。 这个杯子可能是用来饮酒的，清楚地显示了唐朝时对外国形状的模仿。 中国的金匠们经常模仿外国进口货物的形状和风格，并在7世纪中叶开始在中国城市中心定居的中亚工匠的影响下发展了新的技术。

描述_EN: the illustrations on the label were drawn by london-based illustrator steve small. coal was one of three official mascots for the 2002 winter olympic games in salt lake city, utah, usa. the design process was started in september 1997, and a selection of animals went through focus groups with these three being the most popular. in native american legend the black bear represents the quality of strength, for their ability to outlast its hunters. the three characters appeared on a wide range of merchandise, with the plush version here licensed to mattel, and manufactured in china. characteristics of the three animals were based on the olympic slogan ‘faster, higher, stonger’. these salt lake city mascots follow in the tradition of the first official mascot, waldi the bavarian dachshund from munich 1972, in being animals representative of the host region. the final characters were designed by a design partnership of landor associates and publicis.

描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_EN: stella mccartney's collection for swedish high street chain h&m (hennes & mauritz) was launched in november 2005. h&m hosted the launch with a high profile party in london at the st olaves school building,tower bridge. the party included a catwalk show where models dressed in the collection played musical chairs. the jumpsuit is a garment which often appears in stella mccartney's work for her own main line collections, this light silk, loose fit and soft tie belt are all indicative of her relaxed signature style. the media coverage was extensive and when the line was launched at selected h&m stores there were queues along the street and the stock sold out almost instantly. realising that the demand for pieces would be high the items were for sale at a higher price than they had been in the store. between 2004-2008 the popularity of designer collaborations with high street stores was at a peak. within several hours of release numerous pieces appeared on ebay for sale by customers who had bulk bought .
描述_ZN: 2005年11月，斯特拉-麦卡特尼为瑞典高街连锁店H&M（Hennes & Mauritz）设计的系列正式发布。 H&M在伦敦塔桥的圣奥拉夫学校大楼举办了一场高调的发布会。 该派对包括一个T台秀，模特们穿着该系列的衣服玩音乐椅。 连体裤是一件经常出现在Stella McCartney自己主线系列作品中的服装，这种轻薄的丝绸，宽松的版型和柔软的领带都是她轻松的标志性风格。 媒体报道非常广泛，当该系列在选定的H&M商店推出时，沿街排队，库存几乎瞬间售罄。 意识到对产品的需求会很高，这些产品以比商店里更高的价格出售。 在2004-2008年间，设计师与高街商店合作的流行程度达到了顶峰。 在发布的几个小时内，许多作品出现在Ebay上，被大量购买的客户出售。

描述_EN: the museum asked more than sixty people in shenzhen to propose a design object that told a story about their city and the result was an exhibition of twenty-three things and twenty-three stories about the place. the museum opened its own space dedicated to rapid response collecting in july 2014. the invitation to participate in the bi-city biennale enabled the museum to engage with this fast-changing city and to road test the recently introduced rapid response collecting strand. mobile phones with dual sim card slot, 2013 collected on the occasion of the exhibition v&a in shenzhen: rapid response collecting, staged at the 5th bi-city biennale of urbanism and architecture, the value factory, shenzhen. the mobile phones with dual sim card slot were suggested by ffixxed, an art and design consultancy run by kain picken and fiona lau in shenzhen. for the two designers, ‘the dual sim function addresses the problems of cross-border incompatibility between the shenzhen and hong kong phone networks.’ this shanzhai design removes the need for two separate phones for the many people who shuttle between the two cities. today shenzhen is the world’s third busiest container port, with a population with an average age of the less than thirty and almost entirely composed of recent migrants. shenzhen, china’s first special economic zone is located at the tip of the pearl river delta. the shenzhen exhibition was the first opportunity to test rapid response collecting. it runs an android operating system and unlike the iphone, features a removable back to allow access to the sim card slots and battery. by exhibiting everyday objects, the show placed centre stage the realities of urban life, of industry and of commercial and social change. the city grew from a modest fishing town into a vast, sprawling metropolis of more than fifteen million in just thirty-five years, through manufacturing, trade and relentless commercial energy. mobile phones such as these are the product of the shanzhai industry of fakes that has been key to shenzhen’s manufacturing success. this fake iphone 5s imitate the look of apple’s iconic smartphone, but arguably improve on the original by integrating a double sim card slot. this design removes the need for two separate phones for the many people who shuttle between shenzhen and hong kong. this new approach to collecting is intended to make museum collecting more responsive to global events, and to situate design in immediate relation to moments of political or social change.
描述_ZN: 博物馆要求深圳的60多人提出一个讲述他们城市故事的设计品，结果是一个由23件东西和23个地方的故事组成的展览。 博物馆在2014年7月开放了自己的空间，专门用于快速反应收藏。 参加双城双年展的邀请使博物馆能够参与到这个快速变化的城市中，并对最近推出的快速反应收藏系列进行测试。 带双卡槽的手机，2013年，在深圳第五届城市与建筑双年展上展出的 "V&A：快速反应的收集 "中收集，深圳价值工厂。 带有双卡槽的手机是由ffixxed建议的，这是一家由Kain picken和Fiona lau在深圳经营的艺术和设计咨询公司。 对于这两位设计师来说，"双卡功能解决了深圳和香港电话网络之间的跨境不兼容问题。"这个山寨设计消除了许多穿梭于两个城市的人对两个独立电话的需求。 今天，深圳是世界上第三繁忙的集装箱港口，人口平均年龄不到30岁，几乎完全由新移民组成。 深圳，中国的第一个经济特区，位于珠江三角洲的顶端。 深圳的展览是测试快速反应收集的第一个机会。 它运行的是安卓操作系统，与苹果手机不同的是，它有一个可拆卸的背面，可以接触到SIM卡插槽和电池。 通过展出日常用品，展览将城市生活、工业以及商业和社会变革的现实置于中心位置。 通过制造业、贸易和不懈的商业活力，该城市在短短35年内从一个普通的渔镇发展成为一个拥有1500多万人口的庞大的大都市。 像这样的手机是山寨假货产业的产物，是深圳制造业成功的关键。 这个假的iphone5s模仿了苹果标志性的智能手机的外观，但可以说是通过整合双sim卡插槽来改进原版。 这种设计消除了许多穿梭于深圳和香港之间的人对两个独立手机的需求。 这种新的收藏方法旨在使博物馆收藏对全球事件有更多的反应，并将设计与政治或社会变革的时刻直接联系起来。

描述_EN: her figure originated in india as the male deity avalokitesvara, bodhisattva of compassion; after the introduction of buddhism in china, he was transformed into a female deity associated to motherly virtues of piety. like other bodhisattvas, she wears jewellery on the head, torso and arms; on the head, the elaborately worked diadem has in the centre a lotus pedestal, formerly meant for an amitabha figure now missing. guanyin, which literally means 'she who listens to the sound', is one of the most popular buddhist deities in china. in this image, guanyin is portrayed seated in the pose known as lalitasana, or 'royal ease'.

描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_EN: de maar rarely photographs the inhabitants of these spaces but the rooms nevertheless are seen by the artist as portraits of those who live in them. marrigje de maar's series, 'home made' (2003-2006), of which this photograph is a part, is about private, domestic spaces in various countries, including the netherlands, finland, russia, china and japan. personal belongings, and the evidence of habits and daily necessities, give shape to the character of the room and the person. across cultural boundaries, desire for personal space seems to be universal. they share a sensibility with historic dutch 'golden age' paintings of domestic interiors, but combine this with distinctly modern subjects and concerns. her images are made predominantly with available natural light and require long exposures. by dealing with the notion of home de maar's images touch a common personal interest to which all viewers can relate. with this method, she is able to catch authentic states of domestic interiors and not one that is a censured or a version presented for visitors. in most cases, de maar gains admittance by going unannounced from door to door and showing a letter of introduction in the appropriate language. the photographs not only open the door to the private lives of others but also offer a possibility for reflecting on our own.
描述_ZN: de maar很少拍摄这些空间的居民，但这些房间还是被艺术家视为居住在其中的人的肖像。 Marrigje de maar的 "家庭制造 "系列（2003-2006），这张照片是其中的一部分，是关于不同国家的私人和家庭空间，包括荷兰、芬兰、俄罗斯、中国和日本。 个人物品，以及习惯和日常必需品的证据，给房间和人的性格以形状。 跨越文化的界限，对个人空间的渴望似乎是普遍的。 他们与历史上荷兰 "黄金时代 "的家庭内部绘画有着共同的感觉，但与明显的现代主题和关注相结合。 她的图像主要是用现有的自然光拍摄的，需要长时间曝光。 通过处理家的概念，de maar的图像触及了一个所有观众都能感受到的共同的个人兴趣。 通过这种方法，她能够捕捉到家庭内部的真实状态，而不是一个被指责的或为游客呈现的版本。 在大多数情况下，de maar通过挨家挨户的突击检查并出示相应语言的介绍信来获得入场券。 这些照片不仅打开了通往他人私人生活的大门，也为反思我们自己的生活提供了可能。

描述_EN: the sydney olympic games 2000 had three mascots of which millie the echidna (spiny anteater) was one the other two were olly the kookaburra and syd the platypus. the first olympic mascot 'waldi' a daschund dog appeared at the 1972 munich olympic games. mascots are used to communicate the olympic spirit to the general public, especially youth and children. the mascots were commercialised in a range of products, toys and the partnership with mcdonalds. olly, the kookaburra epitomises the olympic spirit of generosity, millie an echidna is a techno-whiz and syd the platypus reflects the environment and captures the vigour and energy of australia and its people. they were designed by matthew hattan and their purpose was clearly outlined by the sydney organising committee of the olympic games (socog). they are usually a character or animal native to the country where the games are being held and showcase the history and culture unique to the host city. it stated 'syd, millie and olly's role [was] to communicate the ideals of the sydney 2000 olympic games… their mission [was] to inspire, entertain, inform and embrace'. together, syd, olly and millie represent earth, air and water. this could be to ensure gender equity but has undoubtedly increased the merchandising potential of the olympic mascot. in more recent years it has been common to have more than one mascot.
描述_ZN: 2000年悉尼奥运会有三个吉祥物，其中针鼹鼠Millie是其中之一，另外两个是袋鼠Olly和鸭嘴兽Syd。 第一个奥运吉祥物 "Waldi "是一只达斯康德犬，出现在1972年的慕尼黑奥运会上。 吉祥物被用来向公众，特别是青少年和儿童传达奥林匹克精神。 吉祥物在一系列产品、玩具以及与麦当劳的合作中被商业化。 年，Kookaburra是慷慨的奥林匹克精神的缩影，Millie是一个技术天才，鸭嘴兽Syd反映了环境并捕捉到了澳大利亚和其人民的活力和能量。 它们是由Matthew Hattan设计的，它们的目的由悉尼奥运会组织委员会（Socog）明确列出。 它们通常是奥运会举办地国家的本土人物或动物，展示主办城市特有的历史和文化。 它说 "Syd、Millie和Oly的作用是传达悉尼2000年奥运会的理想......他们的任务是激励、娱乐、宣传和拥抱"。 在一起，Syd、Oly和Millie代表地球、空气和水。 这可能是为了确保性别平等，但无疑也增加了奥运吉祥物的商业潜力。 最近几年，拥有一个以上的吉祥物是很常见的。

描述_EN: bushell was a physician by profession, but his 30-year-long residence in beijing had made him a self-taught expert. bushell was a physician by profession, but his 30-year- long residence in beijing had made him a self-taught expert. the ceramics bushell selected on behalf of the museum included blue-and-white and colour-enamelled wares which were fashionable in the late 19th century. but he did not overlook the more subtle monochromes which were, a few decades later, much appreciated by collectors and connoisseurs. he made several acquisitions on behalf of the v&a and in 1898 was commissioned by the board of education to write a comprehensive book on chinese art, which has been reprinted several times. it was acquired through the good offices of dr stephen wootton bushell (1844-1908). the elegantly shaped stoneware bowl with a crackled greyish glaze was one of the v&a's early purchases of chinese art.
描述_ZN: Bushell的职业是医生，但他在北京居住了30年，使他成为自学成才的专家。 Bushell的职业是医生，但他在北京长达30年的居住使他成为一个自学成才的专家。 代表博物馆选择的陶瓷器皿包括19世纪末流行的蓝白和彩色珐琅器皿。 但他并没有忽视更微妙的单色，这些单色在几十年后受到了收藏家和鉴赏家的青睐。 他代表V&A进行了几次收购，并在1898年受教育委员会的委托写了一本关于中国艺术的综合书，该书已被多次重印。 它是通过Stephen Wootton Bushell博士（1844-1908）的斡旋获得的。 造型优雅的石器碗，带有裂纹的灰色釉面，是V&A早期购买的中国艺术品之一。

描述_EN: mandeville and olympic mascot wenlock were designed by london-based company iris, and inspired by a short story by children’s author michael morpurgo which told how they were formed by drops of steel in the production of the olympic stadium. mandeville is the official paralympic mascot for london 2012. aimed at children to promote london 2012, the mascots star in their own short film, have a social media presence and appear on a wide range of merchandise. the character features a camera lens for an eye, a taxi light on top of his head, and the three points on its head represent the paralympic symbol. the name comes from stoke mandeville hospital in aylesbury, buckinghamshire, which held games that inspired the modern paralympics.
描述_ZN: 曼德维尔和奥运会吉祥物温洛克是由总部设在伦敦的IRIS公司设计的，其灵感来自于儿童文学作家迈克尔-莫普戈的一个短篇故事，该故事讲述了他们是如何在奥运场馆的建设中由钢滴形成的。 曼德维尔是2012年伦敦残奥会的官方吉祥物。 以儿童为目标来宣传2012年伦敦奥运会，吉祥物在他们自己的短片中出演，在社交媒体上出现，并出现在各种商品上。 这个角色的特点是眼睛是照相机镜头，头顶上有一个出租车灯，头上的三个点代表残奥会的标志。 这个名字来自于白金汉郡艾尔斯伯里的斯托克-曼德维尔医院，该医院举办的比赛激发了现代残奥会。

描述_EN: the coat is available in two styles which follow the classic male (lucien) and female (victoire) trench coat silhouettes. the disadvantage of polyester is that it sheds microplastic when washed. to try to counterbalance this issue, filippa k promotes the use of the guppy friend washing bag. the eternal trench coat was designed in line with the principles of slow fashion, which aims to reduce consumption by manufacturing high-quality, long-lasting products. made from durable and hard-wearing polyester produced from recycled plastic bottles, the coat is designed to last for at least a decade and can be completely recycled when worn out. this reduces the number of microplastic fibres which are shed from friction during washing and prevents them from being released directly into the water system. this versatility in use is a key part of their design, intended to help reduce the overconsumption of clothing. only made in black, the coats are waterproof and lightweight and designed to be worn with layers to enable them to be suitable in both mild and cold weather.
描述_ZN: 该大衣有两种款式，分别是经典的男式（Lucien）和女式（Victoire）风衣的轮廓。 聚酯的缺点是它在洗涤时脱落了微塑料。 为了尝试平衡这个问题，Filippa K推广使用Guppy friend洗涤袋。 永恒的风衣是按照慢时尚的原则设计的，其目的是通过制造高质量、持久的产品来减少消耗。 由回收的塑料瓶生产的耐用和耐磨的聚酯制成，该大衣的设计至少可以使用十年，并且在穿坏后可以完全回收。 这减少了洗涤过程中因摩擦而脱落的微塑料纤维的数量，并防止它们直接释放到水系统中。 这种使用的多样性是其设计的一个关键部分，旨在帮助减少服装的过度消费。 只有黑色，大衣是防水和轻量级的，设计成可以穿多层，使其在温和和寒冷的天气都适用。

描述_ZN: 这意味着，尽管它只有一种颜色，但由于斜纹的对角线与背景的对角线方向相反，所以设计很突出。 这种编织技术在10世纪和14世纪之间在中国特别流行，尽管它在更早的时候被首次引入，并在后来的时代继续使用。 这种棕榈花纹的丝绸是一种斜纹大马士革。

描述_EN: the 3ds introduces, as the name suggests, autostereoscopic 3d to portable gaming. the system opens horizontally with two screens at 135° angle from each other, with the lower screen producing a stereoscopic effect without the need for glasses. the 3ds, on the other hand, produces full colour graphics and autostereoscopic effects, has wifi capabilities and portability, which have helped to make it the fastest pre-release selling game console in the uk, and fastest selling games console ever in australia. the nintendo 3ds is the latest (2011) in nintendo's line of portable games consoles, that started with the simple game & watch series from the 1980s to the release of the game boy in 1989, which brought changeable cartridges to portable gaming. nintendo had been developing 3d gaming since the 1980s and had even released a system based on the monochromatic game boy in 1989, called the virtual boy. a market failure, it was quickly removed from nintendo's roster. due to technical limitations it was large and bulky, included a viewing system attached to a console on a stand and projected wired frame graphics in red on a black screen. this is currently the only console to be able to produce this effect, and is in keeping with the late 2000s resurgence of 3-dimensional viewing - in cinemas and in home television sets.
描述_ZN: 3ds引入了，正如它的名字所暗示的那样，自动立体三维技术到便携式游戏。 该系统水平打开，两个屏幕相互成135°角，较低的屏幕产生立体效果，不需要眼镜。 另一方面，3ds产生了全彩色图形和自动立体效果，具有WIFI功能和便携性，这有助于使它成为英国发售前销售最快的游戏机，以及在澳大利亚销售最快的游戏机。 任天堂3ds是任天堂便携式游戏机系列的最新产品（2011年），从20世纪80年代的简单游戏和手表系列开始，到1989年游戏男孩的发布，它为便携式游戏带来了可更换的卡带。 任天堂自20世纪80年代以来一直在开发三维游戏，甚至在1989年发布了一个基于单色游戏男孩的系统，称为虚拟男孩。 市场失败，它很快从任天堂的名册中删除。 由于技术上的限制，它又大又笨重，包括一个连接在支架上的控制台的观看系统，在黑色屏幕上投射红色的有线框架图形。 这是目前唯一能够产生这种效果的游戏机，并且与2000年代末三维观看的复苏相一致--在电影院和家用电视机中。

藏品名称_ZN: 摩托罗拉mbp26数字视频婴儿监视器
描述_EN: on another thread, the development of these products raises questions of whether these sorts of expensive product are really strictly necessary outside of the medical environment, and whether they ease or heighten the anxieties of parents. the motorola mbp26 consists of two parts: a mains-powered digital video camera and a battery-powered handheld ‘parent unit’. the camera is able to remotely pan and tilt, so parents can try to find better views of their child without disturbing it. its product literature claims it is effective at a distance of up to 300m. it is equipped with infra-red night vision, a high-sensitivity microphone and two-way communication. objects such as these reveal much about the anxiety of new parents when caring for very young children, and how manufacturers create products in response to this anxiety which are designed to ease parents’ fears.
描述_ZN: 从另一个角度看，这些产品的开发提出了这样的问题：在医疗环境之外，这些昂贵的产品是否真的严格必要，以及它们是缓解还是加剧了父母的焦虑。 摩托罗拉mbp26由两部分组成：一个由电源供电的数字视频摄像机和一个由电池供电的手持式 "父单元"。 摄像头能够远程平移和倾斜，因此父母可以尝试在不打扰孩子的情况下找到更好的视角。 它的产品资料声称它在300米的距离上是有效的。 它配备了红外线夜视仪，一个高灵敏度的麦克风和双向通信。 诸如此类的物品揭示了许多关于新父母在照顾年幼孩子时的焦虑，以及制造商如何针对这种焦虑创造产品，以缓解父母的恐惧。
