描述_EN: they are also associated with several european renaissance potentates for whom they were status symbols, fashioned into robes and depicted in paintings of the time. this fragment is part of a group of chinese silks collected from christian church treasuries and believed to have been in europe since the time of their manufacture. the piece is thought to date from the period when the mongols ruled china as the yuan dynasty (1279-1368), as well as controlling a great part of asia. these small-scale patterned silks, which seem not to survive in china or central asia, were desirable and prized additions to the european decorative textile repertoire and reverently used as vestments and wrappings for holy relics.

描述_EN: laurence xu plays with the well-known motifs from the most traditional chinese garment, the dragon robe, in this sumptuous evening dress. another classic motif, the rolling waves at the hem, fittingly cascades down the long flowing train. the dragon robe was full of symbols and the most important of them, the dragon, coils around the body here in a modern take of the full-frontal motif. the dragon robe (known as jifu) of the qing dynasty (1644-1911) was worn during auspicious events by the emperor, his immediate family and by members of the government élite. this is an eye-catching example of the luxury fashion popular in contemporary china, and also illustrates the growing interest chinese have in their cultural heritage.
描述_ZN: Laurence Xu在这件华美的晚礼服中使用了中国最传统的服装--龙袍的著名图案。 另一个经典的图案，下摆处滚动的波浪，恰如其分地从长长的流线型裙裾上垂下。 龙袍充满了象征意义，其中最重要的是龙，在这里以现代的方式围绕着身体的正面图案。 清朝（1644-1911）的龙袍（被称为吉福）是由皇帝、他的直系亲属和政府精英成员在吉利事件中穿着的。 这是在当代中国流行的奢侈时尚的一个引人注目的例子，也说明了中国人对他们的文化遗产越来越感兴趣。

描述_EN: the filter-like part of the cigarette is replaceable and contains the nicotine liquid; the white part contains the battery, recharged by screwing on to a usb attachment. vype brand e-cigarettes are designed and manufactured by cn creative, a division of british american tobacco. since then demand for e-cigarettes has grown exponentially and in 2014 global sales are expected to reach £4 billion. first patented in 1963, the basic design for today’s e-cigarettes was pioneered by chinese pharmacist hon lik, who began manufacturing and exporting his own version in 2003. an electronic cigarette is a battery-powered device that heats and vaporises a liquid containing nicotine to give the sensation of smoking a cigarette but without tobacco. currently, they are marketed both as smoking cessation aids and as a glamorous new consumer product that circumvents smoking bans. there is currently no regulation of the manufacture, sale and promotion of e-cigarettes but their popularity is prompting regulators to take notice. their design closely resembles a traditional cigarette, both in appearance and sensation, with a rubberised coating that attempts to recreate the feel of cigarette paper. british american tobacco was the first of the large established tobacco firms to enter the uk e-cigarette market in 2013. an advertisement for vype aired nearly 50 years after tobacco advertising was banned on british television.

Vype牌电子烟是由英美烟草公司旗下的cn创意公司设计和制造的。 此后，对电子烟的需求成倍增长，2014年全球销售额预计将达到40亿英镑。 第一次获得专利是在1963年，今天的电子烟的基本设计是由中国药剂师韩立开创的，他在2003年开始制造和出口自己的版本。 电子香烟是一种以电池为动力的设备，它加热并蒸发含有尼古丁的液体，给人以吸烟的感觉，但没有烟草。 目前，它们既被作为戒烟辅助工具，又被作为规避吸烟禁令的迷人的新消费品进行销售。 目前没有对电子烟的制造、销售和推广进行监管，但它们的流行正促使监管者注意到。 它们的设计在外观和感觉上都与传统香烟非常相似，有一层橡胶涂层，试图重现香烟纸的感觉。 英美烟草公司是第一个在2013年进入英国电子烟市场的大型烟草公司。 在英国电视上禁止烟草广告近50年后，Vype的广告才播出。

描述_EN: the sensor is mounted beneath the baby’s cot, its visual or auditory alarm is activated if the baby’s breathing stops or becomes irregularly slow. on another thread, the development of these products raises questions of whether these sorts of expensive product are really strictly necessary outside of the medical environment, and whether they ease or heighten the anxieties of parents. the product is somewhat medical- technological in its appearance, in-line with the packaging’s assertion that it is ‘medically certified’. a burglar alarm), rather it is calibrated to detect when an infant ceases its movements. baby motion sensors have been available since 1992. this is not a motion sensor in the familiar sense (i.e. objects such as this reveal much about the anxiety of new parents when caring for very young children, and how manufacturers create products in response to this anxiety which are designed to ease parents’ fears.
描述_ZN: 传感器安装在婴儿床的下面，如果婴儿的呼吸停止或变得不规则缓慢，它的视觉或听觉警报就会被激活。 从另一个角度看，这些产品的开发提出了这样的问题：在医疗环境之外，这些昂贵的产品是否真的严格必要，以及它们是缓解还是加剧了父母的焦虑。 该产品在外观上有一些医疗技术，与包装上声称的 "医疗认证 "一致。 一个防盗报警器），相反，它被校准为检测婴儿何时停止运动。 婴儿运动传感器自1992年起就有了。 这不是我们熟悉的运动传感器（即：防盗报警器）。 这样的物品揭示了新父母在照顾年幼的孩子时的焦虑，以及制造商如何针对这种焦虑创造产品，以减轻父母的恐惧。

描述_EN: the pirates are portrayed as villains, which has generally been the case in the longer-tradition of pirates in children’s culture, although a player can choose to be either navy or pirates, making the goodness or badness of their choice of sides ambiguous. the game references historic conflicts in the early 18th century between 'putrid' pirates and the 'noble' royal navy, which is an interesting topic for a toy, as most pirate toys refer to fictionalised battles between pirates or hunts for buried treasure.
描述_ZN: 海盗被描绘成恶棍，这在儿童文化中海盗的悠久传统中通常是这样的，尽管玩家可以选择成为海军或海盗，使他们选择的立场的好坏变得模糊不清。 游戏提到了18世纪初 "肮脏 "的海盗和 "高贵 "的皇家海军之间的历史冲突，这对玩具来说是一个有趣的话题，因为大多数海盗玩具都提到了虚构的海盗之间的战斗或寻找埋藏的宝藏。

描述_EN: lots-o'-huggin' bear (lotso) for short is a character in the film toy story 3. unlike a lot of toy story characters who are based on real old toys such as mr potato head, lotso was invented just for this film. he is a plush, pink teddy bear with a big plum nose, a sweet strawberry scent and a southern accent. for advertising purposes some fake 1980s television advertisements were made by pixar, the company behind the film, in order to try and convince people that lotso was an old bear. as the leader of the toys at the sunnyside daycare center, he initially acts like a kind-hearted and wise caretaker, but is later revealed to be more of a ruthless warden, although his backstory makes him more of a tragic villain.
描述_ZN: lots-o'-huggin' bear（简称loto）是电影《玩具总动员3》中的一个角色。 不像很多玩具故事中的人物都是基于真正的老玩具，如土豆头先生，Lotuso是为这部电影而发明的。 他是一只毛绒绒的粉红色泰迪熊，有一个大梅花鼻子，有甜美的草莓香味，有南方口音。 为了广告目的，影片背后的公司Pixar制作了一些假的80年代电视广告，以试图说服人们Lotso是一只老熊。 作为sunnyside日托中心的玩具领袖，他最初表现得像一个心地善良和明智的看守者，但后来被发现是一个无情的监狱长，尽管他的背景故事使他更像一个悲剧性的反派。

描述_EN: the museum asked more than sixty people in shenzhen to propose a design object that told a story about their city and the result was an exhibition of twenty-three things and twenty-three stories about the place. the museum opened its own space dedicated to rapid response collecting in july 2014. the invitation to participate in the bi-city biennale enabled the museum to engage with this fast-changing city and to road test the recently introduced rapid response collecting strand. chen says that the shenzhen economy will soon not be so dependent on this kind of production. for chen, the stickers, applied to fake products to make them look more authentic, are ‘a testament to the ingenuity and thoroughness of the shanzhai industry that has helped propel shenzhen these past 30 years. but at the same time, they hint at their own obsolescence. today shenzhen is the world’s third busiest container port, with a population with an average age of the less than thirty and almost entirely composed of recent migrants. shanzhai products, counterfeit or faked consumer goods, are an international cliché of chinese low-cost manufacturing. shenzhen, china’s first special economic zone is located at the tip of the pearl river delta. by exhibiting everyday objects, the show placed centre stage the realities of urban life, of industry and of commercial and social change. the city grew from a modest fishing town into a vast, sprawling metropolis of more than fifteen million in just thirty-five years, through manufacturing, trade and relentless commercial energy. counterfeit stickers, 2013 collected on the occasion of the exhibition v&a in shenzhen: rapid response collecting, staged at the 5th bi-city biennale of urbanism and architecture, the value factory, shenzhen. at some point in the not-too-distant future, these stickers – and all they imply – will be a relic of an earlier era.’ the shenzhen exhibition was the first test of rapid response collecting, a new approach intended to make museum collecting more responsive to global events, and to situate design in immediate relation to moments of political or social change. these stickers, a by-product of the shanzhai fake goods industry, are applied to counterfeit electronic products to make them appear more authentic. these counterfeit stickers were suggested by aric chen, curator of design and architecture at m+ in hong kong.
描述_ZN: 博物馆要求深圳的60多人提出一个讲述他们城市故事的设计品，结果是一个由23件东西和23个地方的故事组成的展览。 博物馆在2014年7月开放了自己的空间，专门用于快速反应收藏。 参加双城双年展的邀请使博物馆能够参与到这个快速变化的城市中，并对最近推出的快速反应收藏系列进行测试。 陈说，深圳的经济很快就会不那么依赖这种生产了。 陈说，这些贴纸被贴在假货上，使它们看起来更真实，是 "对过去30年帮助推动深圳的山寨工业的独创性和彻底性的证明。 但与此同时，他们也暗示了自己的过时。 今天，深圳是世界上第三繁忙的集装箱港口，人口平均年龄不到30岁，几乎完全由新移民组成。 山寨产品，假冒或伪造的消费品，是中国低成本制造业的一个国际惯例。 深圳，中国的第一个经济特区，位于珠江三角洲的顶端。 通过展出日常用品，展览将城市生活、工业以及商业和社会变革的现实置于中心位置。 通过制造业、贸易和不懈的商业活力，该城市在短短35年内从一个普通的渔镇发展成为一个拥有1500多万人口的庞大的大都市。 伪造的贴纸，2013年，在深圳第五届城市与建筑双城双年展上收集的展览V&A：快速反应收集，在深圳的价值工厂举行。 在不远的将来，这些贴纸--以及它们所暗示的--将成为早期时代的遗物。"深圳的展览是对快速反应收藏的第一次测试，这种新方法旨在使博物馆收藏对全球事件做出更多的反应，并将设计与政治或社会变革的时刻紧密联系起来。 这些贴纸是山寨假货行业的副产品，被贴在假冒的电子产品上，使它们看起来更真实。 这些伪造的贴纸是由香港M+的设计和建筑策展人Aric Chen提出的。

描述_EN: the ‘moustache’ detail on the pockets of the coat is found on the toe of the traditional hunter wellington boot. they also wanted to create a look inspired by expeditions into extreme environments, namely outer space and the ocean floor. when creating their debut autumn/winter 2014 collection for london fashion week, hunter aimed to celebrate the brand’s 150 year heritage. this men's ensemble consisting of coat, trousers, bag and boots encapsulates this approach, developing classic british styles, combined with materials inspired by scuba diving.
描述_ZN: 大衣口袋上的 "小胡子 "细节在传统的Hunter Wellington靴子的鞋头上也有体现。 他们还想创造一个灵感来自于对极端环境的探险，即外太空和海底的探险。 在为伦敦时装周设计他们的首次2014秋冬系列时，Hunter旨在庆祝品牌150年的遗产。 这套由大衣、长裤、包和靴子组成的男装套装囊括了这种方法，发展了经典的英国风格，结合了灵感来自潜水的材料。

描述_EN: the 20th century saw soft toys or dolls that served as marketing tools and souvenirs, as well as gifts for small children. two other examples in the museum’s theatre & performance collection are the felt totem girl in rose marie, 1925, and the cotton doll of lupino lane as bill snibson in me and my girl, 1937. with its trademark quiff of red hair and lopsided smile, it captures the essence of tweedy’s zany character and capacity for making audiences laugh. it represents the popular clown tweedy, created by the scottish performer alan digweed who appears annually with giffords circus and cirque berserk, in plays and pantomime, and in his one-man show. souvenir items associated with performance have long been produced for sale, most frequently in the 19th century when the best-selling items were ceramic figures based on performers. this soft toy continues the tradition. the toy was commissioned by tweedy, who sells it at venues where he appears and through his own website.
描述_ZN: 20世纪出现了作为营销工具和纪念品的软体玩具或娃娃，以及给小孩子的礼物。 博物馆的戏剧和表演藏品中的另外两个例子是1925年《Rose Marie》中的毡制图腾女孩，以及1937年《我和我的女孩》中Lupino Lane扮演Bill Snibson的棉花娃娃。 具有标志性的红色头发和倾斜的微笑，它抓住了Tweedy的古怪性格和使观众发笑的能力的本质。 它代表了流行的小丑Tweedy，由苏格兰表演者Alan Digweed创造，他每年都会出现在Giffords马戏团和Cirque Berserk，在戏剧和哑剧中，以及在他的单人表演中。 与表演有关的纪念品长期以来一直被生产销售，最常见的是在19世纪，当时最畅销的物品是以表演者为原型的陶瓷人物。 这个软玩具延续了这个传统。 这个玩具是由Tweedy委托的，他在他出现的地方和他自己的网站上销售。

描述_EN: the flyknit technology allows nike designers to micro-engineer every stitch of the shoe’s upper, scientifically tuned to meet the exact specifications of athletes. the vapormax sole was designed to allow nike to create air bubbles in the sole without having to have a secondary layer of rubber and foam. after five years of development and 195 rounds of adjustments, trainers made with the new technology were first worn at the 2012 olympics by somalia-american long-distance runner abdi abdirahman. nike began working on ‘flyknit’ technology in 2007. it features an upper knit with a super-light, strong fabric, without the weighty structure of traditional shoe making. the pattern is created via a computer program, which allows for infinite subtle, immediate and specific customisation. it is also a far more sustainable method of manufacture than conventional trainer production as instead of cutting irregular shapes from a rectangular cloth, each flyknit upper is knitted exactly to size resulting in very minimal waste. these vapormax flyknit trainers combine two key developments by nike designers in one trainer. this gives greater flexibility and spring without compromising on structure, while also reducing weight and waste.
描述_ZN: Flyknit技术允许耐克设计师对鞋面的每一个缝隙进行微观设计，科学地调整以满足运动员的确切规格。 vapormax鞋底的设计是为了让耐克在鞋底产生气泡，而不需要有第二层的橡胶和泡沫。 经过五年的开发和195轮的调整，采用新技术的训练鞋在2012年奥运会上首次由索马里-美国长跑运动员Abdi Abdirahman穿着。 耐克在2007年开始研究 "flyknit "技术。 它的特点是用超轻、坚固的织物编织鞋面，没有传统制鞋的沉重结构。 它的图案是通过计算机程序创建的，可以进行无限细微、即时和具体的定制。 它也是一种比传统训练器生产更可持续的制造方法，因为不是从矩形布上切割出不规则的形状，每个flyknit鞋面都是完全按照尺寸编织的，导致浪费非常少。 这些vapormax flyknit训练器在一个训练器中结合了耐克设计师的两个关键发展。 这在不影响结构的情况下提供了更大的灵活性和弹簧，同时也减少了重量和浪费。

描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。

描述_EN: the museum asked more than sixty people in shenzhen to propose a design object that told a story about their city and the result was an exhibition of twenty-three things and twenty-three stories about the place. the museum opened its own space dedicated to rapid response collecting in july 2014. the invitation to participate in the bi-city biennale enabled the museum to engage with this fast-changing city and to road test the recently introduced rapid response collecting strand. chen says that the shenzhen economy will soon not be so dependent on this kind of production. for chen, the stickers, applied to fake products to make them look more authentic, are ‘a testament to the ingenuity and thoroughness of the shanzhai industry that has helped propel shenzhen these past 30 years. but at the same time, they hint at their own obsolescence. today shenzhen is the world’s third busiest container port, with a population with an average age of the less than thirty and almost entirely composed of recent migrants. shanzhai products, counterfeit or faked consumer goods, are an international cliché of chinese low-cost manufacturing. shenzhen, china’s first special economic zone is located at the tip of the pearl river delta. by exhibiting everyday objects, the show placed centre stage the realities of urban life, of industry and of commercial and social change. the city grew from a modest fishing town into a vast, sprawling metropolis of more than fifteen million in just thirty-five years, through manufacturing, trade and relentless commercial energy. counterfeit stickers, 2013 collected on the occasion of the exhibition v&a in shenzhen: rapid response collecting, staged at the 5th bi-city biennale of urbanism and architecture, the value factory, shenzhen. at some point in the not-too-distant future, these stickers – and all they imply – will be a relic of an earlier era.’ the shenzhen exhibition was the first test of rapid response collecting, a new approach intended to make museum collecting more responsive to global events, and to situate design in immediate relation to moments of political or social change. these stickers, a by-product of the 描述_EN: in march 2014, facebook acquired oculus for $2 billion, shortly before sony unveiled its own virtual reality headset, project morpheus. at game developer conference in san francisco in march 2014 oculus announced the dk2, which added higher resolution screens, positional tracking and better refresh rates. the dk1 was released for sale on 26 september 2012. the oculus rift development kit 1 is the first version of the headset that was sent out to software developers and programmers. the oculus rift is the leading device that could bring virtual reality – an immersive, three dimensional experience of a computer generated world – into living rooms across the world. what began as a garage invention, then a successful kickstarter campaign, could become a ubiquitous device of home entertainment in the near future. the rift was invented by 21-year-old american tech entrepreneur palmer luckey, who built the prototypes when he was just 18. he hacked together two separate screens (one for each eye) with magnifying glasses that give the rift a unique 90 degree field of vision. it consists of a headset integrating two screens (one for each eye running at 640x800 ppi resolution per eye, adding up to an overall resolution of 1280x800), two aspheric lenses, 9-axis head tracking technology and a cable between the headset and the interface that connects the headset to the computer. this capacity and the lack of lag (the effect when the image on the screen lags behind as you move your head, responsible for motion sickness in other vr headsets) impressed many.
描述_ZN: 2014年3月，Facebook以20亿美元的价格收购了Oculus，不久之后，索尼发布了自己的虚拟现实头盔，Project Morpheus。 2014年3月在旧金山举行的游戏开发者大会上，Oculus宣布了DK2，它增加了更高的分辨率屏幕、位置追踪和更好的刷新率。 DK1于2012年9月26日发布销售。 oculus rift开发套件1是发送给软件开发人员和程序员的头盔的第一个版本。 Oculus rift是一个领先的设备，它可以将虚拟现实--一种对计算机生成的世界的身临其境的三维体验--带入世界各地的客厅中。 从车库发明开始，然后是成功的kickstarter活动，在不久的将来可能会成为一个无处不在的家庭娱乐设备。 裂缝是由21岁的美国科技企业家帕尔默-勒基发明的，他在年仅18岁时就制造了原型。 他将两个独立的屏幕（每只眼睛一个）与放大镜黑在一起，使裂缝具有独特的90度视野。 它包括一个集成了两个屏幕（每只眼睛一个，每只眼睛的分辨率为640x800 ppi，加起来的总分辨率为1280x800）、两个非球面镜片、9轴头部追踪技术以及耳机和连接耳机和电脑的接口之间的电缆的耳机。 这种能力和缺乏滞后性（当你移动头部时，屏幕上的图像会滞后，这在其他VR头盔中会造成晕动症）给许多人留下了深刻印象。

描述_EN: on 14 february 2013 the telegraph newspaper published allegations made by a former employee at a tesco distribution centre in ireland. on 8 february 2013, the financial times ran an article on working conditions at the eight amazon warehouses located across the uk. the motorola wt41n0 is a labour-saving device used by tesco, shoe zone and other retailers. wearable technologies in the workplace hit headlines in february 2013 when newspapers revealed that the performance of warehouse workers was being monitored using data from devices like this one. wearing the device on the wrist or at the hip, the worker uses a finger-mounted scanner or voice-control headset to record activity. if an error is made they receive immediate feedback. he claimed that data collected from wrist-worn devices was being used to grade staff performance, with those not meeting expectations being called before the boss. it is designed to increase accuracy and efficiency in warehouses. devices such as the wt41n0 make possible a new type of work where the organisation of goods and deployment of staff is entrusted to a computerised system. connected to a network, the windows-based microcomputer distributes tasks and tracks their completion. employees interviewed at the rugeley site complained of the blisters developed as they strove to fulfil tasks allocated via handheld computers. this story was the second in a week in the national press to draw attention to wearable computing devices and their impact on the work environment. weighing less than 400g, it is ergonomically designed for prolonged use.
描述_ZN: 2013年2月14日，《电讯报》刊登了爱尔兰特易购配送中心的一名前雇员的指控。 2013年2月8日，《金融时报》刊登了一篇关于亚马逊在英国的八个仓库的工作条件的文章。 motorola wt41n0是一种节省劳动力的设备，被乐购、鞋区和其他零售商使用。 工作场所的可穿戴技术在2013年2月成为头条新闻，当时报纸披露，仓库工人的表现正通过像这样的设备的数据被监控。 将设备戴在手腕上或臀部，工人使用一个安装在手指上的扫描仪或语音控制耳机来记录活动。 如果出现错误，他们会立即收到反馈。 他声称，从腕戴式设备中收集的数据被用来给员工的表现打分，那些没有达到预期的员工被叫到老板面前。 它被设计用来提高仓库的准确性和效率。 像wt41n0这样的设备使一种新型的工作成为可能，在这种工作中，货物的组织和工作人员的部署都委托给了一个计算机化系统。 与网络连接，基于windows的微电脑分配任务并跟踪其完成情况。 在Rugeley基地接受采访的员工抱怨说，当他们努力完成通过手持电脑分配的任务时，会出现水泡。 这篇报道是一周内国家媒体上的第二篇报道，引起了对可穿戴计算设备及其对工作环境影响的关注。 重量小于400克，符合人体工程学设计，适合长时间使用。

描述_EN: the museum asked more than sixty people in shenzhen to propose a design object that told a story about their city and the result was an exhibition of twenty-three things and twenty-three stories about the place. the museum opened its own space dedicated to rapid response collecting in july 2014. the invitation to participate in the bi-city biennale enabled the museum to engage with this fast-changing city and to road test the recently introduced rapid response collecting strand. chen says that the shenzhen economy will soon not be so dependent on this kind of production. for chen, the stickers, applied to fake products to make them look more authentic, are ‘a testament to the ingenuity and thoroughness of the shanzhai industry that has helped propel shenzhen these past 30 years. but at the same time, they hint at their own obsolescence. today shenzhen is the world’s third busiest container port, with a population with an average age of the less than thirty and almost entirely composed of recent migrants. shanzhai products, counterfeit or faked consumer goods, are an international cliché of chinese low-cost manufacturing. shenzhen, china’s first special economic zone is located at the tip of the pearl river delta. by exhibiting everyday objects, the show placed centre stage the realities of urban life, of industry and of commercial and social change. the city grew from a modest fishing town into a vast, sprawling metropolis of more than fifteen million in just thirty-five years, through manufacturing, trade and relentless commercial energy. counterfeit stickers, 2013 collected on the occasion of the exhibition v&a in shenzhen: rapid response collecting, staged at the 5th bi-city biennale of urbanism and architecture, the value factory, shenzhen. at some point in the not-too-distant future, these stickers – and all they imply – will be a relic of an earlier era.’ the shenzhen exhibition was the first test of rapid response collecting, a new approach intended to make museum collecting more responsive to global events, and to situate design in immediate relation to moments of political or social change. these stickers, a by-product of the shanzhai fake goods industry, are applied to counterfeit electronic products to make them appear more authentic. these counterfeit stickers were suggested by aric chen, curator of design and architecture at m+ in hong kong.

描述_EN: in 2013, nest was acquired by global search giant google, raising concerns in the press about data privacy. the nest learning thermostat is a fascinating device, a beautiful object of design, containing within it a potentially threatening future. nest claims this information can reduce home energy consumption by up to 20%. the nest thermostat is a new kind of smart device for the home. the thermostat is intended to appeal to consumers interested in new technologies and innovative product design. the company nest was founded by tony fadell, who previously worked at apple on the ipod and iphone. google, a company which assembles personalised profiles of users of its products based on their online activity in order to deliver targeted advertising, now has a foothold in our homes. loaded with sensors and connected to the internet, it is designed to learn your schedule in order to automatically regulate the temperature of your home. architect rem koolhaas, speaking at a press conference in march 2014, described smart devices such as the nest thermostat as ‘the first step toward an architecture of betrayal’. as with much new technology today, the device provides personalised service in exchange for personal information. this object, and the services it communicates with, neatly capture this contemporary dilemma. part of a generation of products that ushers in the internet of things, the thermostat collects data about your habits – such as when you are at home.
描述_ZN: 2013年，nest被全球搜索巨头谷歌收购，引起了媒体对数据隐私的关注。 nest learning thermostat是一个迷人的设备，一个美丽的设计对象，其中包含一个潜在的威胁性的未来。 nest声称这些信息可以减少家庭能源消耗达20%。 巢穴恒温器是一种新型的家庭智能设备。 该恒温器旨在吸引对新技术和创新产品设计感兴趣的消费者。 公司nest由tony fadell创立，他之前在苹果公司工作，负责ipod和iphone。 谷歌是一家根据用户的在线活动收集其产品的个性化资料以提供有针对性的广告的公司，现在在我们的家里有了立足点。 加载了传感器并连接到互联网，它被设计为学习你的日程安排，以便自动调节你家里的温度。 建筑师Rem Koolhaas在2014年3月的一次新闻发布会上说，像nest恒温器这样的智能设备是 "走向背叛建筑的第一步"。 与当今许多新技术一样，该设备提供个性化的服务以换取个人信息。 这个物体，以及它与之沟通的服务，巧妙地抓住了这个当代的困境。 作为引入物联网的一代产品的一部分，该恒温器收集关于你的习惯的数据--比如你什么时候在家。

描述_EN: in 2016, cnn reported that the average american spends 10 hours+ looking at screens (including, but not limited to the smartphone), and that the average person looks at around 5000+ ads a day (both digital and analogue). irl glasses were sent to backers (supporters of a campaign) in april 2019. at the time of the irl glasses' creation, the irl lab core staff were founder ivan cash, scott blew (head of product & inventor), emily lin, dominic gallelli and james simonetta. the irl ‘screen blocking’ sunglasses were designed by irl labs in san francisco, california (us) in 2018. the irl (‘in real life’) glasses were created by irl labs as a response to the proliferation of digital screens that we come into contact with in everyday life, from tvs in bars to advertising billboards. irl labs have presented the irl glasses to serve as a provocation and critique, and as a proof-of-concept for the future development of glasses that are able to block all digital media. irl glasses were invented by scott blew (irl head of product) and brought to market by irl labs, led by founder ivan cash. the irl glasses are made from solid black plastic with plastic lenses. the irl glasses join the snap spectacles and google glass as examples of technological eyewear, and underlines the impact that digital culture and media has had on eyewear design. the lenses are standard tac 1.1, cat 3, uv 400; with the uv block also function independently as sunglasses. the packaging, designed by brad kayal and manufactured by gpa global (california, us), is a 3-piece box including an internal glasses mount with silver printing, a lenticular box with four animated frames of tv static, and a clear acrylic slipcase with white printing. from their company mission statement, irl labs is ‘a creative incubator empowering humanity to free itself from the unhealthy constraints of technology’. the glasses use a horizontal polarized optics filter that blocks out led and lcd screens, rendering their content unreadable, the screens and content going ‘blank’ as they are viewed. the glasses were manufactured in wenzhou, china, with manufacturer so-pal optics. the outside of the box was designed to be a representation of a chaotic digital environment, with a simple black interior to emphasise the effect of the glasses. however, the glasses do not block 4k video, oled (organic light-emitting diode) or smartphone screens. using kickstarter as their only source of funding, the campaign to raise funds for the glasses was announced on october 1st 2018. their target was successfully reached by october 31st 2018, with $140,920 pledged by 2,030 backers. they were designed to closely replicate the design of the glasses in john carpenter’s 198 film ‘they live’, which serves as the main inspiration for the glasses themselves. by flattening and rotating the polarized lens 90 degrees, light emitted by lcd/led screens is blocked. projects include ‘no tech zone’ in san francisco which designates technology-free areas to provoke non-digital communication, and snail mail my email, which sends emails physically by post. ivan cash is also founder of cash studios, where his looks at the relationship that society has with technology. this simple, lightweight, design allows wearers to choose and limit their exposure to most digital content.
描述_ZN: 2016年，Cnn报道说，美国人平均花10个小时以上的时间看屏幕（包括但不限于智能手机），平均每人每天看大约5000多个广告（包括数字和模拟）。 2019年4月，女孩眼镜被送到支持者（活动的支持者）手中。 at the time of the irl glasses' creation, the irl lab core staff were founder ivan cash, scott blew (head of product & inventor), emily lin, dominic gallelli and james simonetta. irl "阻挡屏幕 "太阳镜是由位于美国加州圣弗朗西斯科的irl实验室于2018年设计的。 irl（"在现实生活中"）眼镜是由irl labs创造的，作为对我们在日常生活中接触到的从酒吧的电视到广告牌的数字屏幕扩散的回应。 irl实验室推出的irl眼镜是一种挑衅和批判，也是对未来能够屏蔽所有数字媒体的眼镜发展的一个概念验证。 irl眼镜由Scott blew（irl产品负责人）发明，并由创始人Ivan cash领导的irl实验室推向市场。 irl眼镜由纯黑色塑料制成，带有塑料镜片。 irl眼镜与snap眼镜和google glass一样是科技眼镜的典范，并强调了数字文化和媒体对眼镜设计的影响。 the lenses are standard tac 1.1, cat 3, uv 400; with the uv block also function independently as sunglasses. 包装由Brad Kayal设计，由GPA Global（美国加州）制造，是一个3件套的盒子，包括一个银色印刷的内部眼镜支架，一个带有四个电视静态动画帧的光栅盒，以及一个白色印刷的透明丙烯酸滑套。 从他们的公司使命声明来看，irl labs是 "一个创造性的孵化器，使人类能够从技术的不健康约束中解放出来"。 该眼镜使用一种水平偏振光学过滤器，可以阻挡LED和LCD屏幕，使其内容无法阅读，屏幕和内容在观看时是 "空白 "的。 该眼镜在中国温州制造，由制造商So-pal optics生产。 盒子的外部被设计成一个混乱的数字环境的代表，简单的黑色内部强调了眼镜的效果。 然而，该眼镜不能阻挡4K视频、OLED（有机发光二极管）或智能手机屏幕。 使用kickstarter作为他们唯一的资金来源，为该眼镜筹集资金的活动于2018年10月1日宣布。 他们的目标在2018年10月31日之前成功达成，由2030名支持者认捐了140,920美元。 它们被设计成密切复制约翰-卡彭特198年的电影《他们的生活》中的眼镜设计，这也是眼镜本身的主要灵感来源。 通过将偏光镜片拉平并旋转90度，可以阻挡LCD/LED屏幕发出的光线。 项目包括在旧金山的 "无技术区"，它指定了无技术的区域，以激起非数字的交流，以及蜗牛邮件我的邮件，它通过邮寄的方式发送电子邮件。 伊万-卡什也是卡什工作室的创始人，他在那里关注社会与技术的关系。 这种简单、轻便的设计使佩戴者可以选择并限制他们对大多数数字内容的接触。

描述_EN: as well as being well-designed and featuring artwork from a number of artists, it has considerable depth and complexity. historically, many games are about violent victory by taking something over, with the emphasis being on the aggressor. spirit island flips that narrative, asking players to be the natives protecting their land, therefore shifting the power. it is overtly political, with the fantasy-cum-alternate history theme firmly framing the european invaders as an oppressive force, intent on the exploitation of resources and environmental ruin. spirit island is an interesting game within the canon of co-operative board games. this positions it within an important and growing group of games with stories that explore politics, histories, experiences and beliefs.
描述_ZN: 不仅设计精良，而且有许多艺术家的作品，它有相当的深度和复杂性。 从历史上看，许多游戏是关于通过占领某些东西取得暴力胜利的，重点是在侵略者身上。 精神岛》翻转了这种叙述方式，要求玩家成为保护他们土地的土著人，因此转移了权力。 它是公开的政治性的，幻想兼替代历史的主题坚定地将欧洲入侵者作为一种压迫性的力量，意图剥削资源和破坏环境。 在合作式棋盘游戏的典范中，《精神岛》是一个有趣的游戏。 这使它处于一个重要的、不断增长的游戏群体中，这些游戏的故事探索政治、历史、经验和信仰。

描述_EN: story dice are designed to encourage imagination by linking the images displayed on the upturned faces into an adventure story. pirate stories have been popular with children for more than two hundred years. over time, the content of children’s pirate stories became increasingly sanitised and stereotyped, removing fictional pirates from their unsavoury historic origins.children’s pirate stories tend to make use of a number of similar themes and elements, and this object distils them into a single game, whilst adding the modern twist of enabling the player to gain superpowers. they offer the appeal of romantic and exciting adventures across the seas to mysterious lands, fighting dreaded rivals and obtaining rich treasures, with pirates playing the roles of heroes, anti-heroes, or outright villains.
描述_ZN: 故事骰子的设计是为了鼓励想象力，将翻转的面孔上显示的图像连接到一个冒险故事中。 海盗故事在儿童中流行了两百多年。 随着时间的推移，儿童海盗故事的内容变得越来越神圣和刻板，使虚构的海盗脱离了他们不光彩的历史渊源。儿童海盗故事往往利用一些类似的主题和元素，这个对象将它们提炼成一个单一的游戏，同时增加了现代的扭曲，使玩家能够获得超能力。 它们提供了浪漫和令人兴奋的冒险的吸引力，跨越海洋到神秘的土地，与可怕的对手战斗并获得丰富的宝藏，海盗扮演着英雄、反英雄或彻底的恶棍的角色。

描述_EN: scrabble trickster has been controversial among traditional scrabble players, and particularly with the north american scrabble players association which runs annual tournaments, for allowing players to use proper nouns, something that has been outlawed since the original version was created. scrabble was first manufactured in 1948, and gameplay involved taking turns to form words from letter tiles in a crossword format. these include instructions such as "steal your opponent's last score", "spell a word anywhere on the board" or "spell a word backwards". for this reason, the north american copyright holder, hasbro inc., has never released it in that territory. this version has the addition of new markings on the classic board, which give the player a chance to use a 'trickster' card. this is an updated version of the classic scrabble board game format, retitled scrabble trickster.
描述_ZN: 拼字技巧在传统的拼字游戏玩家中一直有争议，特别是在举办年度锦标赛的北美拼字游戏玩家协会中，因为它允许玩家使用专有名词，而这是自原始版本创建以来一直被禁止的。 拼字游戏最早制造于1948年，游戏玩法是轮流用字母牌组成单词，以填字游戏的形式进行。 其中包括诸如 "偷取你的对手的最后得分"、"在棋盘上的任何地方拼出一个单词 "或 "倒过来拼出一个单词 "等指示。 由于这个原因，北美版权持有人，哈斯布鲁公司，从未在该地区发行过该游戏。 这个版本在经典棋盘上增加了新的标记，使玩家有机会使用 "诡计 "牌。 这是经典拼字棋游戏格式的更新版本，改名为拼字诀。

描述_EN: the 'creeper' is instantly recognisable to fans of the game. the ‘creeper’ is a hostile character encountered in the minecraft world. minecraft was created by swedish games designer markus ‘notch’ persson. the sprite has become the most recognisable and marketable character, and is usually seen as the mascot of the series. the minecraft online community has been noted by observers as one which is cohesive and mutually supportive. it attacks the player by creeping up on them, then exploding. this hooded sweatshirt, halfway between casual clothing and fancy dress, designed for a boy aged 13-14, shows succinctly how this video game has entered the consciousness of the western teenage world, and how the 'creeper' character has been adopted by many young people as a mark of affiliation. at its most basic, it is a first-person, open-world sandbox game, in which players build constructions out of textured cubes.
描述_ZN: "爬行者 "对于游戏的粉丝来说是一眼就能认出的。 "爬行者 "是在Minecraft世界中遇到的一个敌对角色。 Minecraft是由瑞典游戏设计师Markus 'notch' Persson创造的。 该精灵已成为最易识别和最有市场的角色，并且通常被视为该系列的吉祥物。 观察家们注意到，Minecraft在线社区是一个具有凝聚力和相互支持的社区。 它通过爬上玩家，然后爆炸来攻击他们。 这件连帽运动衫，介于休闲服装和奇装异服之间，为13-14岁的男孩设计，简洁地显示了这个视频游戏是如何进入西方青少年世界的意识，以及 "爬行者 "角色是如何被许多年轻人作为一种归属的标志。 最基本的是，它是一个第一人称的开放世界沙盒游戏，玩家在其中用有纹理的立方体建造建筑。

描述_EN: the ‘rice vessel’ series is inspired by the rice-eating tradition in chinese culinary culture. wang kezhen’s series is produced by a painstaking process: each silver ‘rice grain’ is hand made by honing; meanwhile a ceramic mould is made copying the form of a historic example of ceramic rice bowl; the silver rice grains are then soldered together to from the shape of a vessel using the mould. wang kezhen’s work explores the concept of vessels. because of the importance of rice to chinese cuisine, historically, many special rice cooking and serving vessels have been invented and made with different materials, their forms catered to the need to contain rice grains.
描述_ZN: "米器 "系列的灵感来自中国烹饪文化中的吃米传统。 wang kezhen’s series is produced by a painstaking process: each silver ‘rice grain’ is hand made by honing; meanwhile a ceramic mould is made copying the form of a historic example of ceramic rice bowl; the silver rice grains are then soldered together to from the shape of a vessel using the mould. 王克振的作品探讨了容器的概念。 由于大米在中国烹饪中的重要性，历史上有许多特殊的煮饭和盛饭的器皿被发明出来，用不同的材料制成，它们的形式都是为了满足盛放米粒的需要。

描述_EN: [...] we should accept technology and marry technology'. in october 2019, elite athlete eliud kipchoge broke the record for the fastest marathon while wearing a prototype of the alphafly trainers. the aim with alphafly was to make adjustments to the shoe to improve the efficiency of the runner's movements. from assessments of runners, the team determined that the runners needed further support in the forefoot of the shoe, which resulted in a number of material and technical innovations to create the alphafly, which were released to the consumer marker in the summer of 2020. when asked about the controversy over the alphafly model, kipchoge stated 'we live in the 21st century and we need to accept change/ development goes hand-in-hand with technology. the plate provides stability and stiffness, but also 'rocks' forward, helping propel the wearer into their next step from the front of their foot. the lab was established in 1980 with the goal to study runners in order to design sportswear that optimally suited their needs. the shoe is good. thicker zoomx foam, zoom air pods, and a revolutionary carbon fibre plate all contribute to the alphafly's significant improvements in running economy. today, employing around 40 researchers, the lab draws on expertise in biomechanics, biomedical engineering, and kinesiology to drive innovative developments across the nike brand. whereas the vaporfly model reportedly increases a runner's efficiency by 4% (hence the infusion of the percentage in the name), the alphafly model is claimed to improve running economy between 5 and 8%. the nike sport research lab is recognised for working with athletes and designers to create trainers to enhance performance in a variety of events. while the shoes are recognised as a factor, the kenyan wold and olympic champion's marathon time is a hugely-significant sporting achievement. shoes must also be available to the consumer market to purchase at least four months before being allowed in competitions. a prototype was worn by eliud kipchoge in a record-breaking under two hour marathon. as a result of the shoe innovation and careful race management, kipchoge was enabled to run the first under two-hour marathon. following kipchoge's marathon, the international governing body world athletics announced its first-ever shoe ban, disqualifying any shoes with a sole thicker than 40mm or with more than one carbon fibre plate in elite competitions. these same race-management measures mean that kipchoge's race time of 1:59:40 does not officially count as a world record. these nike alphfly next% trainers, designed by the nike sport research lab in portland, oregon, are designed to optimise an athlete's energy return. focused on long-distance running, the alphafly trainers are an iterative development of nike's zoom vaporfly 4% shoes, introduced in 2017.
描述_ZN: [......]我们应该接受技术，与技术联姻"。 2019年10月，精英运动员Eliud Kipchoge在穿着alphafly训练鞋的原型时打破了最快马拉松的记录。 alphafly的目的是对鞋子进行调整以提高跑步者的运动效率。 从对跑者的评估中，团队确定跑者需要在鞋的前脚掌有进一步的支持，这导致了一些材料和技术的创新，创造了alphafly，并在2020年夏天向消费者标记发布。 当被问及关于alphafly模型的争议时，Kipchoge说 "我们生活在21世纪，我们需要接受变化/发展与技术同步进行。 该板块提供了稳定性和硬度，但也 "摇摆 "向前，帮助推动穿着者从脚的前面进入他们的下一个步骤。 该实验室成立于1980年，目标是研究跑步者，以便设计出最适合他们需求的运动服。 该鞋很好。 更厚的zoomx泡沫，zoom空气舱，以及革命性的碳纤维板都有助于alphafly在跑步经济性方面的显著改善。 今天，该实验室雇用了大约40名研究人员，利用生物力学、生物医学工程和运动学方面的专业知识来推动整个耐克品牌的创新发展。 据报道，在vaporf模型将跑步者的效率提高了4%（因此在名称中注入了百分比），alphafly模型据称可以提高5-8%的跑步经济。 耐克运动研究实验室因与运动员和设计师合作创造训练器以提高各种赛事的表现而被认可。 虽然鞋子被认为是一个因素，但这位肯尼亚的世界和奥运会冠军的马拉松时间是一个非常重要的体育成就。 鞋子也必须在消费者市场上购买，至少四个月后才允许参加比赛。 一个原型由Eliud Kipchoge在破纪录的两小时马拉松比赛中穿着。 由于鞋子的创新和精心的比赛管理，基普乔格得以跑出第一个低于两小时的马拉松。 在基普乔格的马拉松比赛之后，国际管理机构世界田径协会宣布了其有史以来的第一个鞋子禁令，取消了任何鞋底厚度超过40毫米或有一个以上碳纤维板的精英比赛的资格。 这些相同的比赛管理措施意味着基普乔格1:59:40的比赛时间并不正式算作世界纪录。 这些由俄勒冈州波特兰市的耐克运动研究实验室设计的耐克alphfly next%训练鞋，旨在优化运动员的能量回报。 专注于长跑，alphafly训练器是耐克在2017年推出的zoom vaporfly 4%鞋的迭代发展。

描述_EN: the collar is lined with blue self-patterned silk and where the lining has come unstitched a stiff paper interlining can be seen. the lappets seem to have originally been fastened together with silk loops and tiny spherical metal buttons. the collar is open at the front and fastens with two silk loop and knot buttons. each lappet is trimmed with four narrow edgings. each tier is a different colour - green, red, white - and the lappets are of satin embroidered with garden vignettes in mainly seed stitch, satin stitch and gold couching. detachable collar for a woman comprising three overlapping tiers of ruyi-shaped lappets. these still exist but large stitches now keep the lappets joined together. this type of collar is often called a 'cloud collar' and may be for bridal wear.
描述_ZN: 领子的内衬是蓝色的自带图案的丝绸，在内衬解开的地方，可以看到硬纸衬里。 领子似乎最初是用丝环和小球状金属纽扣固定在一起的。 领子在前面是敞开的，用两个丝环和结扣扣住。 每个襟口都有四条窄的镶边装饰。 每一层都是不同的颜色--绿色、红色、白色--并且领子是用缎子绣的，主要是用种子针、缎子针和金线绣的花园小景。 女人的可拆卸领子，包括三层重叠的如意形的花边。 这些仍然存在，但现在大的缝线使帽檐连在一起。 这种类型的领子通常被称为 "云领"，可能是用于新娘服装。

描述_ZN: 领子的内衬是蓝色的自带图案的丝绸，在内衬解开的地方，可以看到硬纸衬里。 领子似乎最初是用丝环和小球状金属纽扣固定在一起的。 领子在前面是敞开的，用两个丝环和结扣扣住。 每个襟口都有四条窄的镶边装饰。 每一层都是不同的颜色--绿色、红色、白色--并且领子是用缎子绣的，主要是用种子针、缎子针和金线绣的花园小景。 女人的可拆卸领子，包括三层重叠的如意形的花边。 这些仍然存在，但现在大的缝线使帽檐连在一起。 这种类型的领子通常被称为 "云领"，可能是用于新娘服装。

描述_EN: the luohan was a member of the buddhist pantheon in china, and the earliest representations can be traced to the 4th century ad. these figures were usually placed in groups near the buddha in temples and monasteries. over time, depictions of luohans evolved from individualized to more formalized portraits. the appreciation for chinese sculpture in europe developed alongside an enthusiasm for earlier chinese ceramics, and during the 1920s and 1930s the museum acquired some outstanding examples, including this luohan. the style of this example suggests that the piece was made in north china where many workshops excelled in carved and painted wooden sculpture. this wooden sculpture represents a luohan, the name for a monk who acts as a guardian of buddhism and is believed to have attained enlightenment through merit and virtue. the use of these images was further encouraged by the chan (zen) buddhist sects, which stressed the importance of having a religious teacher and an interaction between master and pupil.
描述_ZN: 罗汉是中国佛教万神殿中的一员，最早的表现可以追溯到公元4世纪。 年，这些罗汉通常是在寺庙和修道院的佛祖附近成群结队地摆放。 随着时间的推移，对罗汉的描述从个人化演变为更正式的肖像。 在欧洲对中国雕塑的欣赏与对早期中国陶瓷的热情同时发展，在20世纪20年代和30年代，博物馆获得了一些杰出的例子，包括这个罗汉。 这个例子的风格表明，这个作品是在中国北方制造的，那里有许多擅长雕刻和绘画的木雕作坊。 这个木雕代表的是罗汉，罗汉是佛教的守护者，被认为是通过功德而开悟的僧人的名字。 这些图像的使用受到禅宗的进一步鼓励，禅宗强调有一个宗教老师和师徒之间互动的重要性。

描述_EN: the collar is lined with blue self-patterned silk and where the lining has come unstitched a stiff paper interlining can be seen. the lappets seem to have originally been fastened together with silk loops and tiny spherical metal buttons. the collar is open at the front and fastens with two silk loop and knot buttons. each lappet is trimmed with four narrow edgings. each tier is a different colour - green, red, white - and the lappets are of satin embroidered with garden vignettes in mainly seed stitch, satin stitch and gold couching. detachable collar for a woman comprising three overlapping tiers of ruyi-shaped lappets. these still exist but large stitches now keep the lappets joined together. this type of collar is often called a 'cloud collar' and may be for bridal wear.
描述_ZN: 领子的内衬是蓝色的自带图案的丝绸，在内衬解开的地方，可以看到硬纸衬里。 领子似乎最初是用丝环和小球状金属纽扣固定在一起的。 领子在前面是敞开的，用两个丝环和结扣扣住。 每个襟口都有四条窄的镶边装饰。 每一层都是不同的颜色--绿色、红色、白色--并且领子是用缎子绣的，主要是用种子针、缎子针和金线绣的花园小景。 女人的可拆卸领子，包括三层重叠的如意形的花边。 这些仍然存在，但现在大的缝线使帽檐连在一起。 这种类型的领子通常被称为 "云领"，可能是用于新娘服装。

描述_EN: jingdezhen became an important ceramic producer. some kilns active in the preceding decades ceased production, but the longquan, jun, cizhou and jizhou kilns continued their success. kilns became bigger to take advantage of economy of scale and were managed by competent entrepreneurs. the yuan (1271-1368) is the dynasty when china was ruled by mongol emperors. yuan dynasty ceramics are as popular among collectors as their song dynasty predecessors. this piece is a cizhou ware.
描述_ZN: 景德镇成为一个重要的陶瓷生产地。 年，前几十年活跃的一些窑场停止了生产，但龙泉窑、钧窑、池州窑和吉州窑继续保持了它们的成功。 窑场变得更大，以利用规模经济的优势，并由有能力的企业家管理。 元朝（1271-1368）是中国被蒙古皇帝统治的朝代。 元代的陶瓷和宋代的前辈一样受到收藏家的欢迎。 这件作品是一个贵州器皿。

描述_EN: from surviving mamluk textiles, it seems that blue was a favoured colour. similar textiles have not been found in china and it is possible that these silks were made specially for the mamluk empire (1250-1517). mamluk and other textiles from the islamic world are known to incorporate scripts into their designs, so the inclusion of a longevity ideograph may have been a deliberate move. this fragment is part of a group of chinese silks in the v&a collection , broadly dated between the late thirteenth century and the mid-fifteenth century, and supposedly came from the medieval urban centre of fustat in egypt. the pattern of this silk in pale blue and silvery beige consists of a circular medallion with the stylized chinese character shou, meaning 'longevity', and motif of a flaming jewel that fills the spaces in between these medallions. this fragment is part of a group of chinese silks in the v&a collection, broadly dated between the late thirteenth century and the mid-fifteenth century, and supposedly came from the medieval urban centre of fustat in egypt. the weaving may have been carried out in china and the silks then exported westwards, or it could have been done outside china by islamic craftsmen familiar with chinese patterning.
描述_ZN: 从现存的马穆鲁克纺织品来看，蓝色似乎是一种受欢迎的颜色。 类似的纺织品在中国没有发现，这些丝绸有可能是专门为马穆鲁克帝国（1250-1517）制作的。 马穆鲁克和其他来自伊斯兰世界的纺织品都知道将文字纳入他们的设计中，所以加入一个长寿的表意文字可能是一个有意的举动。 这个片段是V&A收藏的一组中国丝绸的一部分，时间大致在13世纪晚期和15世纪中期，据说来自埃及的中世纪城市中心Fustat。 这块淡蓝色和银色米色的丝绸的图案由一个圆形的徽章组成，徽章上有 "寿 "字，意为 "长寿"，徽章之间的空间里有一个燃烧的宝石图案。 这块碎片是V&A收藏的一组中国丝绸的一部分，时间大致在13世纪末到15世纪中叶，据说来自埃及的中世纪城市中心福斯塔特。 织造可能是在中国进行的，然后丝绸向西出口，也可能是在中国以外由熟悉中国图案的伊斯兰工匠完成。

描述_EN: the lotus had always been seen as a flower that 'remained unstained by the muddy surrounding', thus a symbol of uncompromised integrity. each time the scholar composed a literary work he needed to produce ink by grinding an ink cake on an inkstone, adding a small amount of water during the process. the water dropper was an important utensil in the scholar's studio. this jade water dropper in the form of a lotus leaf would have carried an additional meaning. chinese scholars liked to use writing accessories made of jade, because confucius praised jade as 'the embodiment of virtue'.
描述_ZN: 荷花一直被视为 "不受周围泥土污染 "的花朵，因此是不折不扣的诚信的象征。 每当学者创作文学作品时，他需要在砚台上磨制墨饼，在这个过程中加入少量的水。 水滴器是学者工作室的一个重要工具。 这个荷叶形式的玉水滴，会有额外的含义。 中国学者喜欢使用玉石制成的书写配件，因为孔子称赞玉石是 "美德的化身"。

描述_EN: the term 'jun ware' refers to a type of stoneware covered by a distinct glossy and thick glaze ranging in tone from blue to purple. a numeral 'three', in chinese san, is inscribed on its base; this refers to the size of the vessel. jun ware objects have numerals ranging from one, for the largest examples, to ten for the smallest. this vase was used as a flowerpot and placed on a table or desk in the house. objects of this type, generally heavily potted, were produced in henan province in northern china from the northern song dynasty (960-1115) to around 1400s.
描述_ZN: "钧瓷 "一词是指一种由明显的光泽和厚釉覆盖的石器，釉色从蓝色到紫色不等。 a numeral 'three', in chinese san, is inscribed on its base; this refers to the size of the vessel. 钧瓷器物的数字范围从最大的例子的一到最小的例子的十。 这种花瓶被用作花盆，放置在家里的桌子或书桌上。 这种类型的器物，一般都是重瓣的，从北宋（960-1115）到1400年代左右，在中国北方的河南省生产。

描述_EN: the lantern has a globular body and a short neck and foot. the decoration is in the chinese style of doucai or 'dovetailing colours', a process whereby fine porcelain is first decorated in underglaze blue outline and then carefully filled in with overglaze enamels, the latter 'dovetailing' into the outlines. the body has the lambent honey tone that characterises yongzheng porcelain. painted in underglaze blue outline and two shades of green, red and manganese purple, with a sage in a landscape accompanied by two attendants and three goats. a daoist scene is delicately painted in pale enamel colours, the faces outlined in red and contoured with thin red wash. this lantern is made of eggshell porcelain, turned down to a translucent thinness, so that the enamel colours show right through.
描述_ZN: 该灯笼有一个球状的身体和一个短的脖子和脚。 该装饰是中国式的斗彩或 "燕尾色"，这是一种工艺，精细的瓷器首先在釉下蓝色的轮廓上进行装饰，然后仔细地用釉上彩填充，后者 "燕尾 "到轮廓上。 器身具有雍正瓷器特有的淡淡的蜂蜜色。 以釉下蓝为轮廓，以绿色、红色和锰紫色为两种色调，画了一个风景中的圣人，旁边有两个侍者和三只山羊。 用淡淡的珐琅彩精巧地绘制了一个道教场景，脸部用红色勾勒，用薄薄的红色水洗勾勒。 这个灯笼是由蛋壳瓷制成的，翻转到一个半透明的薄度，所以珐琅的颜色直接显示出来。

描述_EN: after 1300, chinese potters at jingdezhen began to decorate the local white porcelain in cobalt blue. but large dishes such as this one were made for export back to the middle east, where the cobalt for the blue had come from. smaller items have chinese shapes and may have been made for the home market. they perfected the painting technique, so that the blue did not run during firing.
描述_ZN: 1300年后，中国景德镇的陶工开始用钴蓝装饰当地的白瓷。 但像这样的大盘子是为出口到中东而制作的，因为那里的蓝色钴是来自中东。 较小的物品具有中国的形状，可能是为家庭市场制作的。 他们完善了绘画技术，使蓝色在烧制过程中不会流淌。

描述_EN: first, thin stripes of a non-precious metal like copper were hammered into pre-chiselled depressions on the surface; then a thin layer of gilding was overlaid on the top. this device obviously helped to economize on precious metals. vases with inlaid decoration, although utilitarian in scope, were generally considered luxury items to display as symbols of wealth and prestige, and as such they often would have been buried in graves after the death of their owner. the production of inlaid vessels was still widespread during the subsequent han dynasty (206 bc-220 ad). in this example, the purple-grey patterns are silver inlays which have tarnished, while the golden patterns are inlaid in two layers. this type of bronze vase, called a fanghu in chinese, is an elegant example of a decorative technique popular in china at the end of the zhou dynasty, around the 4th-3rd centuries bc.
描述_ZN: first, thin stripes of a non-precious metal like copper were hammered into pre-chiselled depressions on the surface; then a thin layer of gilding was overlaid on the top. 年，这种方法显然有助于节约贵金属。 有镶嵌装饰的花瓶，虽然是功利性的，但通常被认为是奢侈品，作为财富和声望的象征来展示，因此它们在主人死后通常会被埋在坟墓里。 在随后的汉代（公元前206年-公元220年），镶嵌器皿的生产仍然很普遍。 在这个例子中，紫灰色的花纹是已经变色的银质镶嵌物，而金色的花纹是分两层镶嵌的。 这种青铜花瓶在中国被称为 "方壶"，是公元前4-3世纪周朝末年流行于中国的一种装饰技术的优雅范例。

描述_EN: porcelain dish with broad rim painted in underglaze blue, overglaze enamels and gilding in imitation of imari ware with a central medallion containing a vase of flowers on a terrace, surrounded by three panels with peonies, birds and flowers in the famille verte colour scheme alternating with three of chrysanthemums and prunus blossoms in red and gold on a blue ground. this ware, produced in the kilns of arita in hizen province, was named after the port in western japan from where it was exported to europe during the 17th and 18th centuries. japanese wares in imary style were imitated at the kilns of jingdezhen from the late 17th century. four flower sprays are on the outside. the decoration in underglaze blue, overglaze enamels and gold imitates the characteristic colour scheme and design of japanese export porcelain in imari style. during the kangxi period (1662-1722) chinese imari became a popular export ware for europe, where several factories, in turn, imitated the style during the 18th century. this large dish was produced at the kilns of jingdezhen in southern china in about 1720-1730.
描述_ZN: 瓷盘，宽边，以釉下蓝、釉上彩和镀金的方式模仿伊玛瑞器皿，中央的徽章上有一个露台上的花瓶，周围有三幅粉彩的牡丹、鸟和花，与三幅蓝底的红色和金色的菊花和梅花交替在一起。 该器物产于肥前省的阿里塔窑，以日本西部的港口命名，在17和18世纪，它从那里出口到欧洲。 日本的仿制品从17世纪末开始在景德镇的窑场被仿制。 外侧有四朵花的喷头。 釉下蓝、釉上彩和黄金的装饰模仿了日本伊万里风格的出口瓷器的特色配色和设计。 在康熙年间（1662-1722），中国的伊玛利成为欧洲流行的出口器皿，在18世纪，欧洲的一些工厂反过来模仿了这种风格。 这个大盘子是在1720-1730年在中国南方的景德镇窑场生产的。

描述_EN: there are lappet borders around the base and the shoulder and a key-fret border around the neck. the relief depicts taoist emblems and flowers, perhaps gardenias, on a ground of cloud scrolls. the bottle is a flattened ovoid form with a flared neck. the high stepped foot has a shallow curved indentation underneath. the flat upper surface of the neck-rim is gilded. it is made of porcelain, moulded in relief with a reticulated surface forming an outer casing over an inner body, and covered with red enamel in imitation of red lacquer. there is a conscious attempt to simulate the decorative motifs as well as the colour and techniques typical of lacquer carving. on the underside of the neck-rim and around the foot there is a line of dots.
描述_ZN: 底部和肩部有花边，颈部有匙形花边。 浮雕在云卷云舒的地面上描绘了道教的纹饰和花朵，也许是栀子花。 该瓶为扁平的卵圆形，颈部外扩的形式。 高台阶的脚下有一个浅浅的弧形压痕。 颈圈的平坦上表面是镀金的。 它是由瓷器制成的，以浮雕的方式铸造，表面是网状的，在内部形成一个外壳，并覆盖着仿红漆的红色珐琅。 有意识地尝试模拟装饰图案以及漆器雕刻的典型颜色和技术。 在颈部边缘的下方和脚部周围有一排小点。

描述_EN: this jar belongs to the so-called longquan wares, characterised by greenish or celadon glazes, and named after an important production area in south china active from the song (960-1279) to the early qing dynasty (1644-1911). this inscription also appears on other pieces produced in the longquan kilns, and possibly represents a trade mark. the longquan vessels were often decorated with designs incised, carved, moulded or applied in relief on the surface, and then covered with the glaze. it is of particular interest for the four chinese ideograms carved in relief under the glaze: 'mei jiu qing xiang' (fine wine, pure fragrance), which directly refer to the function of the jar. a plug would have sealed the mouth. this example, with a short, small neck, was used to serve wine.
描述_ZN: 此罐属于所谓的龙泉器，其特点是绿色或青瓷釉，并以中国南方的一个重要产区命名，该产区从宋朝（960-1279）到清朝早期（1644-1911）都很活跃。 此铭文也出现在龙泉窑生产的其他器物上，可能代表一种商业标记。 龙泉器皿通常以刻、雕、模或浮雕的方式装饰在表面，然后用釉面覆盖。 它对釉下浮雕的四个中国字母特别感兴趣： 梅酒清香"，这直接指的是该罐子的功能。 一个塞子会封住口。 这个例子，有一个短小的颈部，是用来盛酒的。

描述_EN: the peach in he xiangu's basket is a daoist fruit symbolising immortality. over the centuries, all kinds of fantastic tales increasingly embellished the stories of their lives. items such as this bronze object may have come from temples rather than tombs. originally historical persons, the 'immortals' became so in the imagination of successive generations because they were thought of as supernatural beings with extraordinary powers. this candlestick is borne by the bronze figure of he xiangu, one of the eight immortals venerated by the followers of the chinese daoist faith.
描述_ZN: 何仙姑篮中的桃子是道教的水果，象征着不朽。 几个世纪以来，各种奇妙的故事越来越多地美化了他们的生活故事。 像这样的青铜器可能来自于寺庙而不是墓穴。 原为历史人物，"神仙 "在历代人的想象中变得如此，因为他们被认为是具有超自然力量的人。 这个烛台由何仙姑的铜像承受，何仙姑是中国道教信仰者所敬仰的八仙之一。

描述_EN: the bronze mixture used is a most unusual alloy of copper, iron, tin and lead. this bronze buddha head is over one metre high and is all that remains of an enormous statue. the head was cast in sections, and such was the skill of the sculptors, despite the size and a weight of around 100 kilos, it is hollow and the metal itself is only three millimetres thick. the sections are so thin and fine that details like the lips and eyes can be traced in hollow relief inside. such an image would have been very expensive to produce and must surely have come from an important temple.
描述_ZN: 使用的青铜混合物是一种最不寻常的铜、铁、锡和铅的合金。 这个青铜佛首超过一米高，是一个巨大的雕像的全部遗迹。 这个头像是分段铸造的，雕塑家的技术如此高超，尽管它的尺寸和重量约为100公斤，但它是空心的，金属本身只有三毫米的厚度。 这些部分是如此之薄和精细，以至于像嘴唇和眼睛这样的细节都可以在里面的空心浮雕中描摹出来。 这样一尊佛像的制作成本很高，肯定是来自一个重要的寺庙。

描述_EN: the image is nearly entirely gilded, apart from the hair, and was probably once covered by a thin layer of transparent lacquer. buddhism originated in india from the teachings of an indian prince, sakyamuni. he was probably born at the end of the 6th century bc in a small state in nepal, but decided to renounce his royal position to embark upon a monastic life. the bronze figure shows buddha in this precise moment: he is sitting in a meditative posture with his legs crossed, while his right hand extends downward to touch the soil in the symbolic gesture called 'bhumisparsamudra' (touching the earth). after resisting the attacks of mara, the goddess of evil, sakyamuni summoned up the earth goddess to bear witness to his achievement. after leaving his palace and and experiencing various spiritual revelations, he sat under a tree waiting for enlightenment, vowing not to move. this gilt bronze figure represents a crucial event in sakyamuni's life.
描述_ZN: 除头发外，图像几乎全部镀金，而且可能曾经被一层薄薄的透明漆覆盖。 佛教起源于印度，来自印度王子释迦牟尼的教义。 他可能于公元前6世纪末出生在尼泊尔的一个小国，但他决定放弃他的王室地位，开始了僧侣生活。 铜像显示了菩萨在这个精确的时刻：他以冥想的姿势盘腿而坐，而他的右手向下延伸，以象征性的姿态触摸土壤，称为 "bhumisparsamudra"（触摸大地）。 在抵抗了邪恶女神玛拉的攻击后，释迦牟尼召唤了大地女神来见证他的成就。 在离开他的宫殿并经历了各种精神启示之后，他坐在树下等待开悟，并发誓不再移动。 这个鎏金铜像代表了释迦牟尼生命中的一个重要事件。

描述_EN: made around 1410, its closest analogy in terms of technique and decoration is with a rare group of lacquered wooden covers for tibetan buddhist scriptures. the red lacquer has been decorated in the qiang jin (incised gold) technique, whereby the pattern is incised with a sharp point, and subsequently filled with gold leaf. it once had removable extension legs. this low, lacquer table is unique since it is the only piece of furniture that can be associated with any conviction to a lacquer workshop producing items to imperial commission prior to the move of china's capital to beijing in 1423. a variety of uses has been suggested for this table.
描述_ZN: 1410年左右制作的，在技术和装饰方面最接近的是一组罕见的西藏佛教经书的漆器木套。 红漆被装饰在qiang jin（刻金）技术中，即用尖头刻出图案，然后用金箔填充。 它曾经有可移动的延伸腿。 这个低矮的漆桌是独一无二的，因为它是唯一一件可以与1423年中国迁都北京之前的漆器作坊有关的家具，该作坊为皇室提供物品。 这个桌子有多种用途。

描述_EN: when the figures arrived at the v&a they were described as korean, since korean noblemen wore similar wide-brimmed horsehair hats. however, the combination of korean headwear with chinese robes is not known elsewhere, so instead the official probably represents a generic foreign envoy. he is presenting a scroll, possibly with the text of an imperial edict. along with the figure to the right, this larger-than-life sculpture once formed part of a spirit way, with two rows of facing figures and animals leading to a tomb.
描述_ZN: 当这些人物到达V&A时，他们被描述为韩国人，因为韩国的贵族都戴着类似的宽边马鬃帽。 然而，韩国人的头饰与中国人的长袍的结合在其他地方并不为人所知，所以这个官员可能代表一个普通的外国使节。 他正在呈递一个卷轴，可能是皇帝的诏书。 与右边的人物一起，这个比生命还大的雕塑曾经构成了灵路的一部分，两排面对面的人物和动物通向墓穴。

描述_EN: when the figures arrived at the v&a they were described as korean, since korean noblemen wore similar wide-brimmed horsehair hats. however, the combination of korean headwear with chinese robes is not known elsewhere, so instead the official probably represents a generic foreign envoy and is shown presenting a casket that might be a container for a gift or document. his robes are carefully carved to represent cloud-patterned silk and the square badge of rank on his back bears a scaly dragon. like the sculpture to the left, this imposing figure once formed part of a spirit way leading to a tomb of a prince or another member of the imperial clan.
描述_ZN: 当这些人物到达V&A时，他们被描述为韩国人，因为韩国的贵族都戴着类似的宽边马鬃帽。 然而，韩国人的头饰和中国人的长袍的组合在其他地方并不出名，所以这个官员可能代表了一个普通的外国使节，并展示了一个可能是礼物或文件容器的匣子。 他的长袍是精心雕刻的，代表了云纹丝绸，他背上的方形等级徽章上有一条鳞片状的龙。 与左边的雕塑一样，这个雄伟的人物曾经是通往王子或其他皇室成员坟墓的灵路的一部分。

描述_EN: the emperors of the ming and qing dynasties (1368-1911) were patrons of buddhism, and woven silks were frequently used as relic or sutra covers (volumes of buddhist litanies), or for decoration. this fragment was probably woven for use on a buddhist object, although similarly designed textiles were used in japan in tea ceremonies. such textiles woven in patchwork colours were supposed to be reminiscent of early monastic robes.
描述_ZN: 明清两代的皇帝都是佛教的拥护者，编织的丝绸经常被用作文物或经书的封面（佛教的经卷），或用于装饰。 这个片段可能是为佛教物品而编织的，尽管类似的设计纺织品在日本被用于茶道。 这种用拼接颜色编织的纺织品应该是让人联想到早期的僧侣袍。

描述_EN: this one is decorated in underglaze blue with a stylised lotus design, simple banded lines and floral scrolls. it dates to the reign of the yongle emperor (1402-1424) of the ming dynasty (1366-1644). it is often referred to in chinese as a 'bianhu' and is also widely known as a pilgrim flask. the shape of this flask is based on a leather drinking flask traditionally used by the nomadic people of the north west regions of china. this kind of flask is typically of flattened ovoid or circular form.
描述_ZN: 此壶以釉下青花装饰，有风格化的莲花图案，简单的带状线条和花卷。 它可以追溯到明朝（1366-1644）的永乐皇帝（1402-1424）的时期。 它在中文中常被称为 "扁壶"，也被广泛称为朝圣者的酒壶。 这个酒壶的形状是基于中国西北地区游牧民族传统上使用的皮制酒壶。 这种烧瓶通常为扁平的卵形或圆形。

描述_EN: this virupa is one of the largest and most spectacular surviving works belonging to a group of images produced at the chinese court during the early 15th century. close contacts at this time between the emperor yongle (1403-1424), who was himself a buddhist, and tibetan religious leaders, led to frequent diplomatic and religious exchanges. this figure represents the mahasiddha, or great yogic adept virupa, who lived in 9th century north india. visiting tibetans received similar, though usually much smaller images, which were intended to mark and cement such newly made alliances. such figures lived alone or with a consort and became renowned for their unconventional lifestyles.they were revered in tibet as enlightened beings and often feature in tibetan lineages as the teachers of tibetans who journeyed to india to receive buddhist initiation.
描述_ZN: 此佛像是现存最大、最壮观的作品之一，属于15世纪初中国宫廷制作的一组图像。 此时，本身是佛教徒的永乐皇帝（1403-1424）与西藏宗教领袖之间的密切接触，导致了频繁的外交和宗教交流。 此图代表了生活在9世纪北印度的大乘禅师或伟大的瑜伽师维鲁帕。 来访的西藏人也收到了类似的图像，不过通常要小得多，目的是为了标记和巩固这种新建立的联盟关系。 他们在西藏被尊称为开悟的生命，并经常作为前往印度接受佛教启蒙的西藏人的老师而出现在西藏的传承中。

描述_EN: cloisonné was popular in china from the 15th century. pieces from the jingtai reign period (1450-1456) were considered the best. it takes its name from the french word 'cloison', which refers to the barriers of very thin wire that separate one enamel colour from another. here the wires were fixed to the copper body, the glass-like enamels were applied and the piece was fired in a kiln. this vase is decorated with cloisonné enamel, a technique transmitted to china from europe.
描述_ZN: 景泰蓝从15世纪开始在中国流行。 景泰年间（1450-1456）的作品被认为是最好的。 它的名字来自于法语单词'掐丝'，指的是非常细的金属丝屏障，将一种珐琅的颜色与另一种分开。 在这里，金属丝被固定在铜身上，玻璃般的珐琅被涂上，作品在窑中被烧制。 这个花瓶是用掐丝珐琅装饰的，一种从欧洲传到中国的技术。

描述_EN: this bowl is an example of the good quality blue and white porcelain produced during the reign of the ming emperor xuande (1425-35). this bowl, which came to the museum in 1951, has many of the characteristics that would have pleased a collector of chinese ceramics: it is in good condition and of demonstrable 'imperial quality'. its form and decorative style, and the presence of an imperial reign mark painted on its surface, are the key factors by which this bowl can be identified as a product of the imperial porcelain factory for court use. the decoration, consisting of two dragons flying among clouds, was painted in cobalt blue on the plain porcelain body before the application of a transparent glaze. in the post-war decades western collectors' taste in chinese ceramics shifted towards blue and white porcelain produced in the 14th and 15th century, the time of the yuan and early ming dynasties.
描述_ZN: 此碗是明朝宣德年间（1425-35）生产的优质青花瓷的一个例子。 此碗于1951年进入博物馆，具有许多中国陶瓷收藏家所喜闻乐见的特点：它保存完好，具有明显的 "帝王品质"。 其形式和装饰风格，以及其表面所绘的皇室御用印记，是确定此碗为宫廷用瓷器厂产品的关键因素。 图案为两条龙在云中飞舞，是在透明釉前用钴蓝在素瓷器身上画的。 在战后的几十年里，西方收藏家对中国陶瓷的兴趣转向了14和15世纪的青花瓷，也就是元朝和明朝早期的青花瓷。

描述_EN: the sketchy strokes depict a man on horseback accompanied by his assistants, travelling on a precipitous mountain path. the artist's signature and seal can be seen (and almost hidden) on the far right. unlike the works in his typical style, this painting by zhou chen (c.1450 - 1535) employs bolder and looser brushwork, suggesting that it was made by this suzhou artist in his late years. originally painted on the gold-sprinkled paper of a folding-fan (a new format for painting at the time), the work later was mounted as an album leaf. the twin seals on the lower left corner indicate that the painting was once collected by a certain 'shiduan,' a liberary name of a person.
描述_ZN: 简笔画描绘了一个骑马的人在他的助手的陪同下，在一条险峻的山路上旅行。 艺术家的签名和印章可以在最右边看到（而且几乎是隐藏的）。 与他典型风格的作品不同，周臣（约1450-1535）的这幅画采用了更大胆、更松散的笔触，表明它是这位苏州艺术家晚年的作品。 最初画在折扇的洒金纸上（当时一种新的绘画形式），后来作品被装裱成册页。 左下角的双印表明，这幅画曾被某位 "师团"（一种自由的人名）收藏。

描述_EN: granted in 1769, gules three martlets between two chevronels argent (tinctures transposed) with a crest which should be a demi lion rampant per fess ermine and gules ducally crowned or, quartering small, sable on a bend argent three roses gules barbed vert, in the sinister chief point a chess rook of the second, with a coat of pretence and the same accollée, or three cocks gules, probably for cockburn. the arms are marshalled in an interesting manner; peach of rooksmore in gloucs. plate, porcelain, of shallow octagonal form with spreading rim, painted in famille rose enamels and gold with arms of peach quartering small with in pretence and accollée cockburn. all over design is painted within a black and gold border of a chinese family in a garden by a house, a boy flying a butterfly kite, a river landscape behind. the two shields are set in an elaborate framework interlaced with floral sprays.

描述_EN: cloisonné was popular in china from the 15th century. pieces from the jingtai reign period (1450-1456) were considered the best. it takes its name from the french word 'cloison', which refers to the barriers of very thin wire that separate one enamel colour from another. here the wires were fixed to the metal body, the glass-like enamels were applied and the piece was fired in a kiln. this incense burner is decorated with cloisonné enamel, a technique transmitted to china from europe.
描述_ZN: 景泰蓝从15世纪开始在中国流行。 景泰年间（1450-1456）的作品被认为是最好的。 它的名字来自于法语单词'掐丝'，指的是非常细的金属丝屏障，将一种珐琅的颜色与另一种分开。 在这里，金属丝被固定在金属体上，玻璃般的珐琅被涂上，作品在窑中被烧制。 这个香炉是用景泰蓝珐琅装饰的，这是一种从欧洲传到中国的技术。

描述_EN: the cup is similarly decorated on the outside, except that the ladies are standing individually and holding floral sprays. the mark on the base of the cup reads qiyu tang zhi (made by the hall of rare jade). a border of geometrical pattern embellishes the rim. a floral spray is placed between each pair of ladies. other marks consisting of the words qiyu (rare jade) are qiyu meizhi (beautifully made like a rare jade) and qiyu baoding zhizhen (rare jade valuable as a precious tripod). the former appears on a saucer in the v&a (c.1349-1924), and the latter on a pair of bowls (c.927&928-1910) and a pair of vases (c.854&855-1910), all painted with figures in underglaze blue and dating to the kangxi period. four cups of similar size and decoration are in the flagstaff house museum of tea ware, hong kong, three of which carry the qiyu tang zhi mark and one with the character xing (prosperous). small cup and saucer of egg-shell porcelain decorated in underglaze blue. a saucer with the qiyu tang zhi mark, and similar in size to the v&a saucer, went as far as the middle east and is now in the topkapi saray museum in istanbul. hence qiyu tang was probably the name of a kiln that specialised in porcelain decorated with figures. on the base of the saucer is the character qing (to celebrate) within a double circle. on the inside of the saucer is a central panel enclosing a lady seated on a mat on a terrace, around which are arranged four pairs of ladies seated back to back, painted in two tones of blue. on the outside are two pearls and two pictures adorned with ribbons.
描述_ZN: 杯的外壁也有类似的装饰，只是女士们各自站立，手持花束。 杯底的标记是 "奇玉堂制"。 边缘有几何图案的边框点缀。 每对女士之间都有一朵花。 其他由 "奇玉 "组成的标记有 "奇玉美器 "和 "奇玉宝鼎"。 前者出现在V&A（约1349-1924）的一个碟子上，后者出现在一对碗（约927&928-1910）和一对花瓶（约854&855-1910）上，都是釉里红的人物，可追溯到康熙时期。 香港旗杆屋茶具博物馆藏有四只类似尺寸和装饰的杯子，其中三只带有 "启玉堂 "的标记，一只带有 "兴 "字。 小杯和蛋壳瓷碟，以釉下青花装饰。 一个带有 "齐玉堂之 "标记的碟子，与V&A碟子的大小相似，远赴中东，现存于伊斯坦布尔的Topkapi Saray博物馆。 因此，齐玉堂可能是一个专门生产人物装饰瓷器的窑场名称。 在碟子的底部有一个双圆内的 "庆 "字。 在碟子的内侧是一个中央面板，围着一个坐在露台的垫子上的女士，周围排列着四对背靠背坐着的女士，用两种蓝色的色调绘制。 在外面有两颗珍珠和两幅用丝带装饰的画。

描述_EN: this scroll painting or tangka depicts the six-armed mahakala (phonetic tibetan: yeshe gonpo chak zhipa; transliterated tibetan: ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa) with bodhisattvas and bird-headed deities. mahakala is the great protector of buddhist doctrines. he holds a sword and a chopper in his middle and lower-right arms, and a trident and skull cup in his middle and lower-left arms. it is one of a number that show the continuing tibetan and nepalese influences on the buddhist arts of china. a chinese inscription on the lower edge of the tangka dates it to the equivalent of 1478. this was a centre of tibetan buddhist teaching in the north-west of beijing. this phenomenon had begun under the mongol yuan dynasty in the 13th century. this group of tangkas may be linked to the tibetan buddhist temple called ‘temple of great and mighty benevolence which protects the dynasty’.
描述_ZN: this scroll painting or tangka depicts the six-armed mahakala (phonetic tibetan: yeshe gonpo chak zhipa; transliterated tibetan: ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa) with bodhisattvas and bird-headed deities. 马哈卡拉是佛教教义的伟大保护者。 他的中臂和右下臂持有一把剑和一把菜刀，中臂和左下臂持有一把三叉戟和骷髅杯。 它是显示西藏和尼泊尔对中国佛教艺术的持续影响的众多作品之一。 在唐卡的下边缘有一个中国的铭文，它的日期相当于1478年。 这是在北京西北部的一个西藏佛教教学中心。 这种现象在13世纪蒙古人的元朝就已经开始了。 这组唐卡可能与西藏的佛教寺庙有关，被称为 "保护王朝的大慈大悲的寺庙"。

描述_EN: it was almost certainly acquired from a temple in the north-west of beijing, founded under kublai khan and known in the ming period as the da long shan hu guo si ('temple of great and mighty benevolence that protects the dynasty'). an inscription at the bottom of the scroll dates it to the 15th year of the chenghua emperor, equivalent to 1479. tibetan and nepalese monks living in beijing under imperial patronage influenced chinese buddhist art from the time of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368) established by kublai khan (1215-1294). the fierce deities depicted are powerful protectors of buddhism, brandishing a variety of weapons and trampling triumphantly on prone demons. it may have been made by a temple monk. darkened by smoke from incense burned in its former temple setting, this mandala is of a style that owes much to tibetan (and through them, nepalese) styles of buddhist iconography. throughout the ming dynasty (1368-1644), this temple was a centre for tibetan buddhist teaching, and it served as a lodging for many eminent monks. this is a mandala or meditational diagram.
描述_ZN: 几乎可以肯定的是，它是从北京西北的一座寺庙中获得的，该寺庙是在忽必烈汗时期建立的，在明代被称为大龙山胡国寺（"保护王朝的伟大而强大的仁慈的寺庙"）。 卷轴底部的铭文显示它是成化15年的作品，相当于1479年。 生活在北京的西藏和尼泊尔僧侣在皇室的赞助下，从忽必烈（1215-1294）建立的元朝（1279-1368）时期就影响了中国的佛教艺术。 所描绘的凶猛的神灵是强大的佛教保护者，他们挥舞着各种武器，胜利地践踏着俯卧的恶魔。 它可能是由一个寺庙的僧侣制作的。 在以前的寺庙环境中被烧香的烟熏黑了，这个曼陀罗的风格在很大程度上得益于西藏（以及通过他们，尼泊尔）的佛教图标风格。 在整个明代（1368-1644），该寺是西藏佛教的教学中心，也是许多著名僧人的住处。 这是个曼陀罗或冥想图。

描述_EN: the simple stylised lines on the monk’s robe underline the sparse and spiritual aesthetic of the figure as a whole. cast iron came into use for outdoor sculpture during the song dynasty (960–1279) because of a bronze shortage. after casting, the surface was covered with gesso, lacquer, paper and paint. these have since disappeared, to reveal the coarse casting lines that show how the figure was made in sections and then welded together.
描述_ZN: 僧侣长袍上简单的风格化线条强调了整个人物的稀疏和精神美学。 宋代（960-1279）时，由于青铜器的短缺，铸铁开始被用于室外雕塑。 在铸造之后，表面被涂上石膏、漆、纸和颜料。 这些东西后来都消失了，露出了粗大的铸造线，显示了这个人物是如何被分段制作然后焊接在一起的。

描述_EN: the spiritual nature of the bodhisattva is shown in the elongated ear lobes representing wisdom and the long, tied up hair suggesting a continued attachment to this world. a bodhisattva is a being who delays enlightenment in order to help others achieve salvation. his serene, inward expression conveys inner knowledge and a meditative state. the holes in the head were probably for insets of precious stones. this figure is a rare example of a bodhisattva made of cast iron, once stable enough to be displayed outdoors.
描述_ZN: 菩萨的灵性表现在代表智慧的长耳垂和捆绑的长发上，表明对这个世界的持续依恋。 菩萨是一种为了帮助他人获得救赎而延迟开悟的生命。 他宁静、内向的表情传达了内在的知识和冥想的状态。 头部的孔可能是用来镶嵌宝石的。 这个人物是一个罕见的由铸铁制成的菩萨的例子，曾经稳定到可以在户外展示。

描述_EN: from his furrowed brow and closed eyes, we can tell that he is deep in meditation. he sits on a pedestal integral to the sculpture, with apertures for easy handling on either side and an inscription that records the date and donors, 'faithful dang yan and madam mai'. this unusual sculpture stands out, firstly as a chinese depiction of an indian figure, and secondly because of its large size and bright colours. the figure is bodhidharma, a buddhist monk who is believed to have travelled from india to china in 520, bringing meditational buddhism with him.
描述_ZN: 从他紧皱的眉头和紧闭的双眼中，我们可以看出他正在沉思。 他坐在与雕塑融为一体的基座上，两侧有便于操作的孔隙，并有记录日期和捐赠者的铭文："忠实的唐延和麦夫人"。 这个不寻常的雕塑脱颖而出，首先是作为一个中国人对印度人的描绘，其次是它的大尺寸和明亮的色彩。 这个人物是菩提达摩，一个佛教僧侣，据说他在520年从印度来到中国，带来了冥想的佛教信仰。

描述_EN: the enamels were applied directly to what is known as the biscuit or unfired ceramic body. it is made of moulded porcelain and is decorated in a style known as fahua or 'cloisonné-style decoration'. the design was outlined using thick slip and once dry the slip lines were then filled in with enamels using a palette consisting of dark blue, turquoise, yellow and green. the slip lines contained the enamels within the outlined areas during firing and the fired enamels which became unctuous and shiny gave a jewel like appearance to the decoration. this stand was probably intended for the display of a bronze mirror or a jade cong. this technique was first seen on northern tiles in the 13th and 14th centuries and then on a variety of vessels and decorative ceramic wares made in jingdezhen in the 15th and 16th centuries.
描述_ZN: 珐琅彩是直接涂在所谓的饼干或未烧制的陶瓷体上的。 它是由模制瓷器制成的，并以一种被称为法华或 "景泰蓝式装饰 "的风格进行装饰。 图案是用厚厚的滑液勾勒出来的，一旦干燥，滑液线就会被用深蓝、绿松石、黄色和绿色组成的调色板填上珐琅彩。 在烧制过程中，滑线包含了轮廓区域内的珐琅彩，烧制后的珐琅彩变得不粘稠且有光泽，给装饰带来了宝石般的外观。 这个支架可能是用来展示铜镜或玉琮的。 这种技术最早出现在13和14世纪的北方瓷砖上，然后出现在15和16世纪景德镇制造的各种容器和装饰性陶瓷器皿上。

描述_EN: although it looks like a tiger, it has been given a pair of wings. they usually come in pairs, their posture indicating their position in the tombs. thus this left-facing winged beast would have been placed on the right, and would originally have been accompanied by a right-facing beast positioned on the left. pottery models with a similar function have been found in han dynasty (206bc-ad220) tombs. this figure of a mythical animal, made of hollow, dark-grey unglazed pottery, is thought to be the base for a pole. the sizes of these bases vary, but many are in the form of vigorous animals, such as lions and winged rams.
描述_ZN: 虽然它看起来像一只老虎，但它被赋予了一对翅膀。 它们通常成对出现，它们的姿势表明它们在墓中的位置。 因此，这个朝左的带翅膀的野兽应该是放在右边的，而且最初会有一个朝右的野兽放在左边。 在汉代（206BC-AD220）的墓葬中也发现了具有类似功能的陶器模型。 这个神话中的动物形象是由空心的深灰色无釉陶器制成的，被认为是一个柱子的底座。 这些底座的尺寸各不相同，但许多都是充满活力的动物的形式，如狮子和带翅膀的公羊。

描述_EN: this figure is made of loess, which has fired to the reddish colour visible in places where the glaze has flaked off. the figure has a green lead glaze which has become partly iridescent due to burying. the dog had the task of guarding the tomb and driving away evil influences. the fine texture and low shrinkage rate of loess had made it a favourite raw material for northern chinese pottery. however, it melts at a comparatively low temperature, so if a glaze was required this needed to have an even lower melting point. unless properly prepared, high-lead glazes can poison both makers and users of pots alike. it was made during the eastern han dynasty (ad 25-220) and buried in a grave along with other models of animals, farm buildings and daily vessels according to han funerary customs. modern ceramic historians have been intrigued by this development, as high-lead glazes were also used by roman potters, and one theory, still unsubstantiated, is that the chinese were influenced by the romans. copper oxide, was particularly dangerous as it upset the chemical stability of the glaze and caused lead to leach out. the potters therefore used glazes with a high lead content, which had the advantage of producing brilliant colours with warm tones. this earthenware tomb figure depicts a dog with an upturned tail. these animals, together with architectural models such as watch-towers and water-wells, provide a rich insight into the daily life under the han dynasty (206 bc-ad 220). the silvery iridescence on this dog is partly the result of the unstable glaze, but has been exacerbated by burial conditions and is a characteristic feature of han dynasty green mortuary wares. the chinese tradition of sumptuous burials had led to a great variety of ceramic figures of wild and domesticated animals being interred with the deceased in tombs.
描述_ZN: 此图由黄土制成，在釉面剥落的地方烧成了红色，可见其颜色。 该图有绿色的铅釉，由于被埋葬，部分变成了彩虹色。 狗的任务是守卫坟墓和驱除邪恶的影响。 黄土质地细腻，收缩率低，是中国北方陶器最受欢迎的原料。 然而，它的熔化温度相对较低，所以如果需要釉料，这需要有更低的熔点。 如果没有适当的准备，高铅釉会使制壶者和用壶者都中毒。 它是在东汉时期（公元25-220年）制作的，根据汉代的丧葬习俗，与其他动物、农场建筑和日常器皿的模型一起埋在坟墓里。 现代陶瓷历史学家对这一发展很感兴趣，因为罗马的陶工也使用了高铅釉，有一种理论，至今仍未得到证实，那就是中国人受到了罗马人的影响。 氧化铜特别危险，因为它破坏了釉料的化学稳定性，导致铅的浸出。 因此，陶工们使用了高铅含量的釉料，其优点是可以产生温暖色调的亮丽色彩。 这个陶制墓俑描绘了一只尾巴上翘的狗。 这些动物和建筑模型，如瞭望塔和水井，提供了对汉代（公元前206年-公元220年）日常生活的丰富洞察力。 这只狗身上的银色虹彩部分是由不稳定的釉料造成的，但由于埋藏条件而加剧，是汉代绿色殡仪馆的一个特征。 中国传统的奢华葬礼导致了大量的野生和驯养动物的陶瓷形象与死者一起被埋葬在坟墓中。

描述_EN: the apocryphal reign mark of jiajing is written in six characters in large, bold script with in a double ring on the base. dish of saucer shape with sides moulded in eight simple lobes and rim with eight bracket foliation; low foot tapered on the outside; patches of grit adhering to it. the eight panels round the sides are filled with various diaper patterns including cash, scale, two kinds of t-fret, two textile-like patterns, and two with motives in reserve: a fan on a ground of key-fret, and a conch in a four-pointed cartouche on a ground of key-fret, and a conch in a four-pointed cartouche on a ground of swastika diaper. round the outside are eight large emblems in ribbons: the ruyi head, horn cups, conch, musical stone, ruyi head, pair of fish, canopy and musical stone repeated. painted in the centre with an octagonal panel containing a design of four fish swimming among swirling waves, sprinkled among which are also auspicious emblems: the conch, coral, jewel, rhinoceros-horn cups, books, paintings, lozenges, and another conch, also a small dragon and a flaming pearl.
描述_ZN: "嘉靖年号 "由六个大字写成，字体粗犷，底部有一个双环。 dish of saucer shape with sides moulded in eight simple lobes and rim with eight bracket foliation; low foot tapered on the outside; patches of grit adhering to it. 侧面的八块板充满了各种纸纹，包括现金、鳞片、两种T字纹、两种类似纺织品的纹样，以及两种带有备用图案的纹样：匙形纸地的扇子，以及匙形纸地的四角花纹中的海螺，和卍字纸地的四角花纹中的海螺。 外面有八个大的纹饰带：如意头、角杯、海螺、乐石、如意头、一对鱼、天幕、乐石重复。 中央绘有八角形面板，内有四条鱼在漩涡中游动的图案，其中还有一些吉祥物：海螺、珊瑚、珠宝、犀牛角杯、书、画、菱形、另一个海螺，还有一条小龙和一颗火红的珍珠。

描述_EN: (cc 4/2/1985) some qing examples are shown in ''gugong qiqi tezhan mulu'' (taipei, 1981) nos 85-87. the technique seen on this object is known in the modern chinese literatrue as 'xipi' (rhinoceros hide), though there is discussion as to whether this is the 'xipi' mentioned in text of per-ming and ming date. this also illustrates a box closely comparable to the present piece, dated by the author as 'ming'. the fullest technical explanation is given by yuan quanyu (wife of wang shixiang), 'tan xipi qiqi' ''wenwu cankao ziliao'' 1957.7 pp.1-7.
描述_ZN: (CC 4/2/1985) 一些清代的例子见于 "古玩特展穆鲁"（台北，1981）第85-87号。 在这件物品上看到的技术在现代中国文献中被称为 "西皮"（犀牛皮），尽管对于这是否是在明清时期的文本中提到的 "西皮 "还有讨论。 这也说明了一个与本品很相似的盒子，作者认为是明代的。 最全面的技术解释是由袁泉玉（王世襄的妻子）给出的，"Tan xipi qiqi' ''Wenwu cankao ziliao'' 1957.7 pp.1-7。

描述_EN: the value and sophistication of the container were proportionate to the importance of the recipient and had special social significance. the inside is plain so that it could accommodate different types of food. the recipient of the box would have returned it with another gift enclosed as a sign of gratitude. the surface design of this box is known as jian huan, literally 'sword pommel rings', and was obtained by carving the alternating layers of red and black lacquer applied to the wooden base. this fine lacquer box was used in the 16th century to present edible gifts.
描述_ZN: 该容器的价值和精致程度与接受者的重要性成正比，具有特殊的社会意义。 里面是素色的，这样就可以容纳不同类型的食物。 收礼者会将盒内的另一份礼物归还，以示感谢。 这个盒子的表面设计被称为 "剑环"，字面意思是 "剑柄环"，是通过雕刻涂在木质底座上的红色和黑色的漆层而得到的。 这个精美的漆盒在16世纪被用来赠送可食用的礼物。
